target_definitions.name: accurate (per decision)
target_definitions.definition: accurateDecision(engineEvalCp, cpLoss) = winProbabilityLoss(engineEvalCp, cpLoss) <= ACCURATE_WIN_PROBABILITY_LOSS, where ACCURATE_WIN_PROBABILITY_LOSS = winProbabilityLoss(ACCURATE_CP_LOSS / 2, ACCURATE_CP_LOSS) and ACCURATE_CP_LOSS = 30 (anchored at +15cp, the worst case: 30cp costs 2.761 points there). 'no decision the old rule called accurate is called inaccurate by this one.'
target_definitions.thresholds: 30 cp anchor; win-probability loss at eval 15 of a 30cp loss (~2.761 points). At eval 0 up to 30cp accurate; eval 300 up to 38cp; eval 500 up to 58cp; eval 1000 up to 212cp.

target_definitions.name: calibration gap (per decision and per bucket)
target_definitions.definition: decisionGap(d) = d.confidence − (d.accurate ? 1 : 0); bucket gap = meanConfidence − accuracyRate; gapVariance = Bessel-corrected sample variance of per-decision gaps, forced to 0 if all gaps identical. Positive = overconfident.
target_definitions.thresholds: none itself; manifest requires minimum_meaningful_effect > 0

target_definitions.name: separable candidate pattern (shipped detector)
target_definitions.definition: For bucket B: gapDifference = gap(inside) − gap(outside); SE = sqrt(var_in/n_in + var_out/n_out) (null if either n < 2 or var <= 0); candidate iff |gapDifference/SE| >= separabilityK and n_in >= minBucketN and n_out >= minBucketN; decisions missing the bucket's field are in neither side.
target_definitions.thresholds: Scan (six buckets): MIN_BUCKET_N = 30, SEPARABILITY_K = 3.75. Pre-named single bucket (onlyBucketKey): PREREGISTERED_MIN_BUCKET_N = 20, PREREGISTERED_SEPARABILITY_K = 3.25. MAX_SHUFFLED_FALSE_POSITIVE_RATE = 0.02 (GATE-SHUFFLE ceiling); measured worst 0.7%.

target_definitions.name: oracle judge (D04 search)
target_definitions.definition: On the validation half: difference = mean(gap inside region) − mean(gap outside); se = sqrt(var_in(ddof=1)/n_in + var_out(ddof=1)/n_out); validated iff abs(z) >= 3.75 with n_in, n_out >= 30. 'ABSOLUTE, like the shipped test'.
target_definitions.thresholds: SEPARABILITY_K = 3.75; MIN_BUCKET_N = 30; records with derivation or validation < 60 decisions → 'too-short'

target_definitions.name: on-target (D04)
target_definitions.definition: Jaccard(found region on validation half, planted region on validation half) >= 0.60. 'If the search recovers fast AND endgame exactly, Jaccard is 1. If it recovers fast alone... Jaccard is the endgame share of fast decisions, which is around 0.2–0.3.'
target_definitions.thresholds: ON_TARGET_JACCARD = 0.60 (declared before the run)

target_definitions.name: false-claim rate ceiling
target_definitions.definition: Share of null-world records on which a claim is validated. Rejection rule (D04): 'rejected unless it improves correct attribution without raising the false-claim rate past 0.02'.
target_definitions.thresholds: FALSE_CLAIM_CEILING = 0.02; measured: shipped chain 0/8,000 (upper CI 0.00048); search depth 1 0.0008, depth 2 0.0010 on 4,000; shuffled control 0.0006

target_definitions.name: attribution veto
target_definitions.definition: Within the claimed bucket's validation decisions, for each other bucketing: split readable decisions by its predicate; if both halves >= MIN_SPLIT_N, z = (gap_half − gap_rest)/SE; breaks iff |z| >= k. Verdict not-attributable names the split with the largest |z| (ties toward positive gapDifference). Bucket needs >= 2*MIN_SPLIT_N inside.
target_definitions.thresholds: ATTRIBUTION_K = 2.5 (chosen as smallest k with worst false-veto <= 10% over clean plants); MIN_SPLIT_N = 15; false-veto ceiling 0.10; turn-on trigger 60 validation games

target_definitions.name: mirror finding (bucket-variable)
target_definitions.definition: A level clearing on the opposite sign of the strongest level in the same variable; reported as consequence, not as a second claim. Strongest level = max |gapDifference|/standardError within the variable.
target_definitions.thresholds: none; measured mirror rates 19.5% (opening) / 17.8% (endgame) pre-fix; 1.0–3.0% through the chain

target_definitions.name: Frozen hypothesis identity
target_definitions.definition: hypothesis_id = SHA256(canonicalJson({...manifest, predicate: canonicalPredicate(predicate)})). One semantic byte changed = a different hypothesis that cannot inherit evidence.
target_definitions.thresholds: HYPOTHESIS_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1; minimum_meaningful_effect > 0; alpha in (0,1); 0 <= spent_before < alpha; derivation_game_ids_hash length 64

relevance_to_mission: Direct relevance, mostly as constraints: (1) The repository's only search vocabulary is 7 fixed cuts over 3 pre-move features (phase, seconds<45, clock_ms<60000) at depth <= 2, run only in a Python oracle on simulated worlds; the mission's contexts (opening, colour, material, phase x clock) are mostly outside the vocabulary — opening/material/colour belong to D17 'semantic chess features', which is DEFER until 'the statistical mechanism is proven' (undefined). Colour is not on the DecisionAtom at all in the files read. (2) The target the whole chain is built on is the calibration gap (stated confidence − accuracy); the owner's ~2,209 Lichess games carry no stated confidence, so the chain's target is undefined on the mission corpus and only `accurate` (cp_loss-derived, depth 12 in the mission vs engine-parity concerns in decision-atom) remains — searching `accurate` was killed in q7 only because confidence was a selector, so it is not intrinsically forbidden, but nothing here has measured a search on an accuracy-only target. (3) The unit-of-inference finding is load-bearing: decisions cluster in games; ICC has never been measured on a real record; D02's reversal condition 'Records reach roughly 50 games' fires immediately on a 2,209-game corpus, so the decision-level SE cannot be assumed there and the clustered/bootstrap comparison 'must be re-run before that is assumed either way'. (4) The mission's 'stable under resampling' (L3) is D06, deliberately shut until D04's depth is settled; 'predictive on held-out' (L2) is the derive-half/freeze/judge-half discipline in q7 and hypothesis-manifest (derivation_game_ids_hash, stopping_rule in GAMES). (5) The mission's core question — are two mistakes 'the SAME mechanism' — is exactly what D08 attribution addresses in the negative direction (is the named region the answer or a container for it) and D04 in the positive direction (can a region be named); both say a subgroup is a REGION, not a mechanism, and neither claims mechanism identity. (6) The freeze contract (D09) gives the shape an L5 'frozen intervention' must take: predicate, direction, minimum_meaningful_effect, protocol re-derived from feature condition kinds, error budget, derivation-games hash. (7) Point-in-time leakage rules (D01/D03): commit-timestamp cutoff; TARGET and VALIDATION_ONLY roles refused; DeepGameFeatures (post-game aggregates including opening/material) are the named leak risk. (8) The real-corpus false-claim rate is D04's first reversal condition and has never been measured — the mission corpus is where it would be.
contradictions: D04 'WHAT WOULD REVERSE IT' says: 'The full distribution is in results/q7_candidate_search.json; if the on-target rates move sharply with the threshold, the line was a choice and not a separation.' The committed q7_candidate_search.json stores per plant only {validated, validated_rate, on_target, on_target_rate, median_jaccard, regions[top 3]} — no per-record Jaccard distribution. Reversal condition 4 cannot be evaluated from the stored file without a re-run.

target_definitions.name: Transfer success / grade replicated (shipped, flag off)
target_definitions.definition: successes = count of positions where scoreRecall(recalled_rule, action_rule).clearedFloor AND accurateDecision(engine_eval_cp, cp_loss); 'replicated' requires TRANSFER_MINIMUM_SUCCESSES=2 of TRANSFER_POSITION_COUNT=3 on two separate passing days; grading symmetric (refuted on two distinct failing dates); grades hypothesis/replicated/refuted/retired.
target_definitions.thresholds: 2 of 3; two distinct dates; RETRIEVAL_INTERVAL_DAYS = [1, 3, 7, 21]; accurateDecision threshold NOT stated in files read (lives in shared/detector.ts). Null: 9–65% P(replicated) at plausible base rates.

target_definitions.name: b_valid (binary action signature, old screen)
target_definitions.definition: 1 iff the engine's single best move is in B(s).
target_definitions.thresholds: RC-06 .968 (T+) / .200 (T-), separation +.768; old eligibility A1_measurable, A2_beats_chance, A3_efficacious, A4_discriminating, A5_beats_incumbent (RC-01 +0.600 old scale). A5 refuted on xs scale.

target_definitions.name: Rule-consistent action (T+ hit) and false application (T- rule-consistent action)
target_definitions.definition: Played move satisfies B on a T+ item / on a T- item; reported separately with Wilson intervals; never as single accuracy.

target_definitions.name: Gate A action-set quantities
target_definitions.definition: V_B(s) = max U(s,a) a in B; V_notB(s) = max U a not in B; A_B = V_B - V_notB (advantage); R_B = V* - V_B (regret of obeying); regret distribution over all permitted moves (median/p75/p90/max, mean blunder share); 'safe' = within 100 cp of best.
target_definitions.thresholds: No universal acceptance threshold. Eligibility revised to C11 AND permitted-set regret distribution. p90 = 1.0000 on five classes (RC-00, RC-06, RC-08, RC-12, RC-04 ~0.999). RC-05 p90 0.0000; RC-03 p90 0.1249. False comfort: permitted move loses >= 0.25 xs; boundary: >= 0.5 xs; harm: >= 100 cp.

target_definitions.name: C11 (noise-cell criterion) and C12 (proposed)
target_definitions.definition: C11: does the trigger-negative cell carry information (prescription size on T- as the sentence states it): MEASURABLE / VACANT / SATURATED (7/8/2 of 17). C12: among players who did NOT follow the rule, what did it cost them (one search per T+ item with recorded move).
target_definitions.thresholds: C12 for RC-05: .926 nothing / .054 >= 0.10 expected score. C12 'proposed, not adopted'.

target_definitions.name: Yield of an intervention (decisions worth changing)
target_definitions.definition: P(trigger fires) x P(player declines) x P(declining costs >= 0.10 xs).
target_definitions.thresholds: RC-05: 0.206% x 42.5% x 5.4% ~ 4.7e-5 per sampled position -> INSUFFICIENT_OPPORTUNITIES.

target_definitions.name: Natural-retest primary endpoint
target_definitions.definition: primary dP(Y|X): action given the cue on an uncued natural opportunity, before vs after intervention; mandatory dP(Y|not X). Desired: P(Y|X) rises, P(Y|not X) does not meaningfully rise; a rise in both = CRITERION_SHIFT. Reported against move-blind floor.
target_definitions.thresholds: No numeric threshold; result classes TRANSFER_SUPPORTED, TRANSFER_NOT_SUPPORTED, CRITERION_SHIFT, RECOGNITION_BLOCKED, ACTION_SELECTION_BLOCKED, MEASUREMENT_INVALID, INSUFFICIENT_OPPORTUNITIES. Secondary (never bundled): regret of chosen action, P(admissible action), win-probability loss, calibration error, decision time, spontaneous cue detection, transfer latency.

target_definitions.name: Outcome hierarchy level required before any claim of learning
target_definitions.definition: Level 3 or above: player detects X without a rule-specific cue and chooses Y in an ORDINARY game; plus T- term beside it; non-saturated noise cell; mayPrescribe at 'tested' (forward test that could have come back negative); fix for finishLearningTransfer.
target_definitions.thresholds: Levels 0–6 (E5 hierarchy); P4 reached Level 2 on presented items; ecological ladder L2 instrument vs L5 target.

target_definitions.name: Study D hypotheses
target_definitions.definition: H0: once strength and item are controlled, detection adds no predictive information about rule-consistent action. H1: detection predicts rule-consistent action. Mixed-effects logistic, random intercepts participant and item, strength band covariate; DETECT-FIRST vs MOVE-FIRST order difference = reactivity estimate.
target_definitions.thresholds: 8–30 participants, one sitting, 1200–1600 prioritised; freeze item bank, twins, model, hypotheses, reactivity comparison before first participant; no interim look.

target_definitions.name: P3 decision rule
target_definitions.definition: regret = v_star_xs - move_xs; pairs of B moves same position with gap >= 0.01; pairwise ranking accuracy; PASS requires pooled M2 > 0.50, CI(M2-M1) > 0, CI(M2-M0) > 0, M2 > 0.50 in all 3 held-out classes, >= 2/3 class CIs > 0.

target_definitions.name: P4-N1 decision rule
target_definitions.definition: PASS requires: test TARGET >= baseline + 0.25; test TARGET >= 0.75; CONTROL does not fall > 0.25; >= 6/8 test TARGET interpretable; no cue/correctness exposed before baseline. TARGET item: cue feature differs and ranks the lower-regret move correctly; CONTROL: cue feature equal despite regret gap >= 0.10.
target_definitions.thresholds: Observed 0.75 -> 1.00 TARGET; CONTROL 0.75 -> 1.00. Guards: stop if no feature stable in 3/3 LOCO; stop if < 20 TARGET positions; specificity NOT IDENTIFIED if < 8 CONTROL.

target_definitions.name: Pressure-Exposure C1–C4
target_definitions.definition: C1 OwnExposure_post coefficient positive in all 3 folds and L+Epost > L with CI > 0; C2 OpponentPressure_post negative in all 3 and L+Ppost > L CI > 0; C3 L+Epost+Ppost > L+Epost CI > 0 in pooled, positive in 3 classes, >= 2 class CIs > 0; C4 delta signs stable and L+Edelta+Pdelta > L CI > 0. Verdicts PE-PASS / PE-POST-PASS / PE-EXPOSURE-ONLY / PE-FAIL.
target_definitions.thresholds: Observed: C1 PASS (+5.76 pp [+3.93,+7.68]); C2, C3, C4 FAIL.

target_definitions.name: Power / sample constants
target_definitions.definition: MIN_BUCKET_N = 30 (detector.ts); four-arm power table (0.2->1,004; 0.3->446; 0.5->161; 0.8->63); within-participant ~152 items per condition to separate 0.60 from 0.75; WWC SCD v5: 5+ points in each of 6+ phases, 3 demonstrations.
target_definitions.thresholds: as listed

target_definitions.name: Population accuracy by time bucket (D20)
target_definitions.definition: shared/population-baseline.ts: slow-over-2m 50.7% accuracy vs 64.9% outside; fast-under-45s holds 99.7% of a blitz player's decisions (B2 study).
target_definitions.thresholds: as stated; 'accuracy' definition not restated in D20

relevance_to_mission: Everything in this area is POPULATION or N-of-1-on-presented-items evidence; none of it is about the owner (erez281) or his ~59k decisions, and no engine-free player-specific mechanism is proposed here. What transfers to the mission: (1) D21 gives the only owner-record-applicable measurement in the area: split the existing record by decision order (early vs late halves, n >= MIN_BUCKET_N = 30 per half) to test whether exposure moves the calibration gap -- runnable now, no schema change; until then discovery may not assume exposure is uniform. (2) D20 gives the rule that an environment claim (clock/time) cannot be closed by a protocol that removes the environment, and that protocol requirements are the UNION over a predicate's features -- directly constraining how a cross-context mechanism claim (different clock, phase, material) may be validated. (3) The field-intervention design skeleton that survived: trigger = a frozen, versioned, board-only predicate evaluated by the system (never the player's sentence; GATE-CUE-PLAYER-OBSERVABLE); delivery = post-game packet 'WHEN X -> DO Y' hidden during DECIDE (packetVisible=false wherever producingEvidence=true), shadow-mode first; sham = matched perturbation that does not flip the trigger (item-level sham established for RC-05 twins; a human sham/attention arm was specified as 'Control: past-error explanation only' and is NOT EXECUTABLE); denominator = every opportunity recorded whether or not the rule fires, T- opportunities on the same terms, per-game opportunity rate scanning every ply (never measured); stopping rule = freeze retest before decision, result classes incl. INSUFFICIENT_OPPORTUNITIES and CRITERION_SHIFT, no interim redesign. (4) The yield arithmetic (base rate x decline rate x cost of declining) is the go/no-go for any owner-specific mechanism: a mechanism whose opportunities are rare or cheap is not worth an intervention (RC-05: ~4.7e-5 per position). (5) Identifiability: dP(Y|X) vs dP(Y|not X) carries no information under a saturated noise cell (0.500) -- any owner mechanism needs a non-degenerate T- cell. (6) Killed instruments the mission must not reuse: accurateDecision/engine agreement as rule use, accuracy alone, pre/post without concurrent controls, SDT criterion c as a player parameter on branching predicates, b_valid as safety. (7) Warning about the mission's own framing: 'process evidence' and 'final move is insufficient in general' are forbidden claims per D25; clusters/similarity are never treated as mechanisms here either -- RC-06 was 'an observed survivor, not an explained family'. (8) The only human-validated cue (post_own_overloaded_piece_count, exposure-after-move) is a candidate-conditional pre-commit feature that the owner could in principle be tested on, but it is a population cue at L2, not a player-specific mechanism.

features.name: trigger_state (T+/T−/None) per rule class
features.definition: rule_classes.py: trigger(board, ctx) → 'positive' | 'negative' | None; pure function of the board plus Context(prev_move, prev_was_capture); 'NO ACCESS TO THE PLAYED MOVE'
features.admissible_for_discovery: Yes per C1 (trigger precedes behaviour, enforced by signature). Docs do not partition discovery vs validation; the stated rule is a frozen, versioned predicate (rule_class_version 1.0.0) — 'A definition change is a new board_predicate_version and a new bank.'
features.admissible_for_validation: Yes if frozen before behaviour is read; two triggers (RC-13, RC-21) were found to name a condition they do not test — 'A scope predicate needs its own scope audit'
features.leakage_notes: None from the player's move. Caveat: T+ and T− are not exchangeable (max |SMD| 0.573 on RC-06; 0.487 on RC-01) so T itself correlates with material balance, phase, legal-move count.

features.name: observable_action / move ∈ B (satisfies)
features.definition: satisfies(board, move, ctx) → bool; one move in, boolean out, no engine (C2/C7). Recorded as observable_action int(sat) in scan records.
features.admissible_for_discovery: It is the response, not a predictor: 'move ∈ B → CONDITIONAL DISCRIMINATION: CONTRAINDICATED' on RC-06 (99.4% of legal moves satisfy the as-stated rule on T−). Usable only where C11 grades the class MEASURABLE and one predicate is scored on both cells.
features.admissible_for_validation: Only under a BehavioralTransferSpec with ONE response predicate identical on both cells; on RC-06 'B-membership may not be called rule-consistent action'
features.leakage_notes: Computed from the committed move — post-move by definition. For RC-06/RC-12 the shipped predicate branches on the trigger (different act on each cell). observable_action is nullable in ITEM_BANK_PROTOCOL ('null is not zero').

features.name: prescription_size (per-item chance rate)
features.definition: share of legal moves satisfying B on the item = |satisfying_moves| / |legal_moves|; 'the share of legal moves that satisfy B is what picking a permitted move at random would score' (G4). Reported as mean and median per cell; under shipped and as-stated predicates.
features.admissible_for_discovery: Yes — board-only, no engine; used as the positive-cell guard and, via C11, the negative-cell guard
features.admissible_for_validation: Yes as chance rate 'per item, never a pooled constant' (IDENTIFIABILITY_SIMULATION uncertainty column)
features.leakage_notes: None. RC-03's high rate (.543 T+) shows it captures geometry (few legal moves in check).
features.where_defined: rule_classes.py RuleClass.satisfying_moves; c11_screen.py; rule_class_screen_raw.json c4 prescription_size_mean/median

features.name: b_valid (B_valid | T+, B_valid | T−)
features.definition: 'Stockfish 17.1 at 200,000 nodes is asked for its own best move, and that move is asked whether it satisfies B. The rule never grades itself.' Share of items where engine-best ∈ B.
features.admissible_for_discovery: It is an item/rule-class property (engine oracle on the position), not a player feature; admissible for grading a rule class, never as a player measurement
features.admissible_for_validation: Only as a specificity statistic where C11 = MEASURABLE; separation on SATURATED/VACANT classes 'is a fact about its predicate'
features.leakage_notes: Uses the engine oracle; does not read the human move. Engine build matters little for top-1 (SF16 vs 17.1 agree to ~0.004) but action-set values untested (U6). Only asks about the BEST member of B — cannot see robustness.

features.name: position_features covariates: n_legal_moves, n_legal_captures, n_checks_available, n_mate_in_1, n_forcing_moves, in_check, piece_count, actor_material, opponent_material, material_balance, total_material, phase, fullmove_number, halfmove_clock
features.definition: predicates.py::position_features(board): counts over legal moves (captures, checks, mates-in-1 via push/pop, forcing = captures ∪ checks); material by PIECE_VALUE per colour; phase = 'endgame' if total ≤ 24 else 'opening' if fullmove ≤ 10 else 'middlegame' ('a convention, not a finding', matching shared/phase.ts)
features.admissible_for_discovery: Yes — 'The covariates F2 says T+ and T− must be compared on, computed from the board alone'; every one is 'a candidate confound'
features.admissible_for_validation: Yes as balance covariates; '[NO JUSTIFIED THRESHOLD]' for acceptable SMD
features.leakage_notes: None. Measured population SMDs (T+ − T−, round-1 predicate): material_balance −0.487, n_legal_moves −0.486, attackers +0.475, piece_count −0.312.

features.name: prev_move, prev_was_capture (Context)
features.definition: 'Both fields describe the opponent's last move, which is available before our turn begins and is therefore admissible under C1.' Used by RC-02 recapture trigger/satisfies.
features.admissible_for_discovery: Yes (RULE_CLASS_SEARCH overturned ITEM_BANK_PROTOCOL's rejection: 'history before the player's turn is available before behaviour')
features.leakage_notes: Must be passed as a parameter, not a board attribute ('A parameter cannot be forgotten; an attribute can').

features.name: actor_elo, opponent_elo, time_control, source_ply, source_game_id, fen, in_check
features.definition: Scan record base fields from PGN headers and board state
features.admissible_for_discovery: Yes; rating is 'the only skill covariate'; time control 'recorded and not modelled' (OT-3)
features.admissible_for_validation: Yes as covariates; in-check positions excluded for all classes except RC-03 ('a forced reply is not a free choice')
features.leakage_notes: None; but 2013 rating distribution is not today's (OT-1)

features.name: scope predicates: _lone_king_defends, _only_the_king_can_stop_it, _exactly_one_thing_hanging, _knight_check_a_queen_could_not_give, _opponent_has_no_pieces, matched same-from/same-to promotion
features.definition: Pure functions (board, ctx) → bool measuring the distance between a trigger and the condition its class is named after (C10); _only_the_king_can_stop_it is a SUFFICIENT condition (errs toward exclusion)
features.admissible_for_discovery: Yes for scoping; _lone_king_defends REFUTED as the rule-of-the-square precondition (functional holds on 53.6% of what it certifies)
features.admissible_for_validation: Only the functional predicate; 'the recursion has to stop at a measurement rather than at a sentence'
features.leakage_notes: None

features.name: SEE (see_result, swap algorithm), engine_result{best_move,best_cp,best_mate}, engine_capture_cp_loss, regret_B, advantage, V*, V_B, V_notB, max_regret_in_B, permitted_moves_safe, chance_advantage
features.definition: Oracles in separate fields (F4): SEE reproduced from CPW with x-ray limitation (OT-6); engine at 200k nodes; action-set: V* = max(V_B, V_notB), regret_B = V* − V_B (efficacy), advantage = V_B − V_notB (necessity), robustness = V* − V(a) over a ∈ B; per-item size-matched random prescription as chance control; expected score (WDL sf16) primary, cp never averaged
features.admissible_for_discovery: As item properties yes; 'No oracle that interprets an item may define it' (req. 8); SEE ≥ 0 on 100% of round-1 T+ by construction so uninformative there
features.admissible_for_validation: As value adjudication only; 'never as ground truth'; the utility scale saturates on already-won positions (RC-00 V* = 1.000)
features.leakage_notes: Engine numbers are computed on the position/prescribed set, not the human move; but engine_capture_cp_loss of the played move is post-move. outcomeLeakControl asserts stripping all oracle fields leaves the SDT table identical.

features.name: Round-1 item fields: target_square, target_piece, target_value, geometric_defenders, defender_types, attacker_count, legal_captures, defence_definition ('direct-attackers-only' | 'lichess-ray-defence'), defended_under_ray_rule, competing_motifs{mate_in_1_available, capture_gives_check, larger_capture_elsewhere, target_capture_is_also_fork|null, target_capture_is_also_discovery|null}
features.definition: ITEM_BANK_PROTOCOL.md Item schema (specified, not built as a bank); predicate v1.0.0 = exactly one capturable undefended non-pawn enemy piece, direct attackers only
features.admissible_for_discovery: Yes, board-only
features.admissible_for_validation: Yes; ray-defence flips 0.64% of T+; T− defended only by pinned pieces 0.33%
features.leakage_notes: None; lichess_themes is solution-conditioned and 'may never be read by anything that assigns trigger_state'

features.name: Lichess puzzle covariates: puzzle rating, lichess_themes (hangingPiece etc.), is_valid_attack selection (> 0.7 win-chance gap)
features.definition: Frame B curated corpus; hangingPiece computed from puzzle.mainline[1].move; puzzle_position_rule 'board(FEN) then push(Moves[0]); solution is Moves[1]'
features.admissible_for_discovery: Only as an independent label 'to disagree with'; REJECT as a source of T
features.leakage_notes: Theme is a property of (position + solution + continuation) — B inside T.

features.name: DecisionAtom production fields: entry_state.fen, ply, phase, clock_ms_remaining, decision, bounded_action.seconds_taken, bounded_action.confidence (+confidence_scale, confidence_grid_version), bounded_action.candidate_moves_considered (touch order), probe{assignment, legal_moves, answered, alternative, alternative_cp_loss}, stated read known/unknown/known_parts/unknown_parts (tapped vs typed)
features.definition: shared/decision-atom.ts per decision, frozen before reveal (V5/V6); confidence asked non-randomly (confidence-asked.ts); probe present on unprobed decisions too
features.admissible_for_discovery: Per INCREMENTAL_EVIDENCE_VALUE: time KEEP (+.29 on L7 only); confidence 'KEEP, do not add' (a report about the decision, produced after it); candidate set KEEP 'and read it narrowly' (+.010 on A/B, noise elsewhere; presence near-conclusive, absence uninformative; 'nothing built on this array may be monotone in its length'); candidate order KEEP (only handle on C1-vs-C2); probe arm KEEP. None moves C/D off .500 on a saturated cell.
features.admissible_for_validation: Only live decisions (imported PGNs have empty candidate arrays); chose-past-it base rate unmeasured (R2)
features.leakage_notes: fen/ply/phase/clock are pre-move; seconds_taken is during-decision; candidate_moves_considered is during-decision (pre-commit); confidence and stated read are same-sitting reports ('cannot by itself establish precedence'); probe is post-commit; result.engine_eval_cp / engine_best_move / engine_depth / engine_source are post-reveal outcome fields.

features.name: Experimental conditions (not sensors): timed condition, delayed condition (delay > 0, uncued), generic (contentless) cue arm, rule-specific cue
features.definition: BehavioralTransferSpec fields delay (0 | >0), cue (none | generic | rule-specific), setting (task | drill | ordinary play | blitz)

target_definitions.name: separation
target_definitions.definition: separation = b_valid|T+ − b_valid|T− (RULE_CLASS_SEARCH; CURRENT_STATE U1). A specificity statistic ONLY if one response predicate is scored on both cells (C11 MEASURABLE).
target_definitions.thresholds: G5: separation > refuted incumbent RC-01's +0.600 (void — RC-01 VACANT). Rebuilt scale: floor = chance separation (psz|T+ − psz|T−), ceiling = RC-00 corrected +0.765; corrected separation = observed − chance separation.
target_definitions.where_defined: RULE_CLASS_SEARCH.md 'The five gates'; ANCHOR_REBUILD.md; rc06_fixed_predicate.json gate_G5

target_definitions.name: b_valid (prescriptive validity C4)
target_definitions.definition: share of items on which Stockfish's best move satisfies B; reported per cell with Wilson CI; items where nothing satisfies B counted not dropped ('B_valid among items where something does' reported separately)
target_definitions.thresholds: G4 beats chance: B_valid|T+ > mean prescription_size on T+ (no fixed number). Engine: Stockfish 17.1, 200,000 nodes, Threads 1, Hash 64; 250 items/cell.

target_definitions.name: C11 grade
target_definitions.definition: Grade of the trigger-negative cell under the response predicate as the class's own prescription sentence states it (as_stated for SUBSTITUTES classes, shipped otherwise). SATURATED: mean prescription size on T− ≥ 0.95. VACANT: no legal move satisfies the rule on ≥ 95% of T− items (constant VACANT = 0.05, test empty ≥ 1 − VACANT). MEASURABLE: neither. UNGRADED if mean is None.
target_definitions.thresholds: '.95 is a description of "almost all", stated in advance, and every class is far from it: the SATURATED pair are at .994 and .999, the VACANT eight at exactly .000, and no MEASURABLE class is above .381.' RC-13 prohibition reading .948 'just below the cut'.

target_definitions.name: The criterion for a usable noise cell
target_definitions.definition: 'A rule class has a usable noise cell only where, with the trigger absent, the prescribed act STILL EXISTS and can be WRONG.' RC-02 recapture is the design template: 'Same act, same question, different truth value.'
target_definitions.thresholds: checkable before any search; classes satisfying it (no substitution, MEASURABLE): RC-00, RC-02, RC-03, RC-04, RC-05, RC-13, RC-21

target_definitions.name: Gates G1–G5 (top-1 screen)
target_definitions.definition: G1 structural: c3_grade is not defined-by-a-chosen-action; G2 testable: both cells produced items under the candidate's own exclusion; G3 occurs: trigger fires in an unfiltered corpus (C9); G4 beats chance: B_valid|T+ > mean prescription_size on T+; G5 beats the incumbent: separation > RC-01's separation in the same run
target_definitions.thresholds: all comparisons, 'No threshold is invented'; RC-13 the only class to fail G4

target_definitions.name: Gates A1–A5 (action-set model)
target_definitions.definition: A1_measurable, A2_beats_chance, A3_efficacious (regret of obeying), A4_discriminating, A5_beats_incumbent (chance-corrected advantage separation vs RC-01 +0.564136 on xs)
target_definitions.thresholds: A5 void on expected-score scale (ceiling +0.3444920000000001 < floor); every row fails A5; RC-20 also fails A3

target_definitions.name: Action-set quantities
target_definitions.definition: V* = max(V_B, V_notB); efficacy regret_B = V* − V_B; necessity advantage = V_B − V_notB; robustness = V* − V(a) for every a ∈ B; 'safe in B' = share of permitted moves within 100 cp of best; chance control = size-matched random prescription drawn on the same item
target_definitions.thresholds: no cut for robustness ('No non-arbitrary cut exists'); 100 cp = 'blunder' is 'convention, and labelled as one'; chance advantage between −0.07 and −0.42 xs by class

target_definitions.name: C10 grades
target_definitions.definition: asserted-and-unchecked (code skips a precondition its own docstring asserts; scope_predicate REQUIRED at import), declared-and-separately-tested, tested-by-the-trigger
target_definitions.thresholds: n/a; RECONCILIATION §2.4 vocabulary: NO_STATED_SCOPE_GAP / STATED_SCOPE_GAP_MEASURED / SEMANTICALLY-UNDERDEFINED

target_definitions.name: SDT quantities (population, round 1 and per rule class)
target_definitions.definition: hits/misses/false alarms/correct rejections from preregistered T and recorded act; hit rate, false-alarm rate with Wilson intervals (z = 1.96); d′, criterion c, β, A′, B″_D per Stanislaw & Todorov (1999); loglinear correction (Hautus 1995, +0.5/+1) applied to every table; 2AFC conversion d′₂AFC ≈ √2·d′yn
target_definitions.thresholds: 'Accuracy is not a primary quantity and is not reported alone, ever.' [NO JUSTIFIED THRESHOLD] for reliability, reactivity, item/person variance ratio, SMD balance, SCED index. Move-blind agent scores d′ 0.80, c +0.88 on RC-06 from predicate sizes alone.
target_definitions.where_defined: ANALYSIS_PLAN.md §1.1 and 'Every threshold in this program'; sdt.py/ts; equivalence/sdt_grid.json

target_definitions.name: Identifiability gate
target_definitions.definition: 'A construct is UNDERIDENTIFIED if material latent states remain observationally equivalent under the proposed measurement protocol.' Not classification accuracy > X. Bayes-optimal two-hypothesis accuracy, chance = 0.500, learners rate-matched so P(B | T+, untimed) = .716; P(B | not applying) = min(1, β × per-item chance rate), β = 2 (reproduces observed T− rate 2 × .104 = .21 vs measured .192–.200); between-participant time offset SD 8 s; 20 and 40 items per condition; 4,000 trials
target_definitions.thresholds: C/D fixed predicate .500 at all rungs and both sizes; branching .983 (20) / .998 (40) from 'move, both cells'; L7 caps ≈ .78–.80; A/B .863 move only

target_definitions.name: Evidence levels E0–E7
target_definitions.definition: E0 sentence/hypothesis; E1 domain semantics; E2 item/observation mapping; E3 human construct validity; E4 causal intervention; E5 delayed uncued transfer; E6 ecological transfer; E7 replication
target_definitions.thresholds: Reached E1; E2 attempted not reached; 'Required for any product-visible learning claim: E5.'

target_definitions.name: Ecological ladder L0–L5 (docs/measurement) — NOTE: different from the mission's L0–L6
target_definitions.definition: L0 explicit recognition (rule named and shown); L1 cued application; L2 uncued application, constructed position; L3 uncued application, representative choose-a-move (sampled from real games); L4 prospective opportunity in ordinary game review; L5 behaviour during natural blitz play — the target claim. 'They are never summed, averaged, or reported as one number.'
target_definitions.thresholds: Current design 'L2, aspiring to L3, and it does not reach L3 today'; preconditions for L5 study: 1 of 5 met

target_definitions.name: BehavioralTransferSpec
target_definitions.definition: trigger_predicate (pure function, no move parameter, C10-audited AND its scope predicate audited); response_predicate ONE predicate identical on both cells; positive_cell; negative_cell scored by the SAME response predicate; chance_rate per item; harm (regret of prescribed act and of worst permitted act); delay; cue; setting
target_definitions.thresholds: 'A spec whose negative cell has a chance rate near 1 has no negative cell.'

target_definitions.name: Round-1 unprotected-piece predicate v1.0.0 and exclusions
target_definitions.definition: T+ = exactly one opponent non-pawn piece legally capturable with zero geometric (direct-attacker) defenders; T− = held target; B = 1 if the player captured the designated target. Exclusions frozen in order: side to move in check → excluded; ≥2 loose targets → UNKNOWN; no capturable non-pawn piece → UNKNOWN; ply < 2 → excluded; unrated → excluded from rating-conditioned analysis; human 'ambiguous' → excluded from scoring
target_definitions.thresholds: fires 20.4% of classifiable game positions; N3 narrowing = T− restricted to SEE < 0 captures

target_definitions.name: LearningRule grading (production)
target_definitions.definition: gradeLearningRule requires two successful days for `replicated` and two failed days for `refuted` (V8); formLearningRule files a rule as `hypothesis` and schedules 1/3/7/21 without consulting mayPrescribe (V7)
target_definitions.thresholds: three positions/two successes reaches `replicated` 47–81% of the time in one sitting from base rates; 9–65% across two days (F9 in CURRENT_STATE)
target_definitions.where_defined: CURRENT_STATE.md V7, V8, F9; MULTI_STRATEGY_REGISTER.md Register 4

target_definitions.name: Rule for entering a human study
target_definitions.definition: 'A rule class may not enter a human study unless at least one mechanism pair that would change the next intervention is separable by an observation that study will actually collect.'
target_definitions.thresholds: RC-06 under Study D separates none of M1/M3/M9

relevance_to_mission: Direct and cautionary. (1) Everything in this area is POPULATION evidence — 60,000 unfiltered 2013-01 Lichess games (60,834 seen), 180,000 sampled positions, plus 6.1M puzzles — and NOT the owner (erez281). No claim here is about a person ('Humans measured: 0'). The mission's requirement to separate population from player-specific evidence is met trivially: nothing here is player-specific. (2) The lineage is a worked demonstration of exactly the failure the mission forbids — treating a correlation/agreement statistic (separation +0.768) as a mechanism when the two cells scored different acts; and of a 'cluster of mistakes' (mate-threat misses) not being a capability. It supplies the machine-checkable guard the mission needs before calling two mistakes 'the same mechanism': C11 — with the trigger absent, does the prescribed act still exist and can it be wrong? Any candidate player-specific mechanism stated as 'if T, act so that T is gone' (outcome-shaped) will have a degenerate T− cell by construction; C/D (conditional discrimination vs response bias / 'does this everywhere') is at .500 under every observation set, and no amount of time/candidate/cue data repairs it. That is the exact L1→L2 trap (cross-context pattern that cannot beat the 'performs B everywhere' baseline). (3) Reusable machinery: the pure-function trigger/satisfies signature (no move parameter), the scan record schema (fen, prev_move, prev_was_capture, actor/opponent elo, time_control, position_features) to regenerate on the owner's ~2,209 games/59k decisions; prescription_size as the per-item chance rate; C11 grading; the anchor scale with chance as floor; the exchangeability covariates and the itemDifficultyConfound control (an agent with zero ability produces large d′ on unbalanced items — the mission's 'different opening, colour, phase, material, clock' contexts are exactly such imbalance); the forbidden-claims list (18 sentences). (4) Currently MEASURABLE classes whose act stays defined on both cells: RC-00, RC-02 recapture, RC-03, RC-04, RC-05 safe-promotion, RC-13, RC-21 — with RC-05 (+0.454 corrected, 59% of ceiling, base rate 0.22%) and RC-02 (+0.364, 48%, base rate 11.67%) the two worth screening. RC-02's base rate makes it the only one plausibly countable on a single player's ~59k decisions. (5) Vocabulary collision: the repo's L0–L5 ladder (cued/uncued/ecological) and E0–E7 evidence levels are NOT the mission's L0–L6 signal→validated levels; do not map them one-to-one. (6) The area's own stop rule: 'When a feature has no live decision it can change, do not build it' is echoed here as the encodability-bias gate ('We can build it is never sufficient permission'); the repository ranks the chose-past-it base rate (a SELECT over stored decisions) as the highest-value no-human action, and RC-05's base-rate count as the next.

killed_paths.where: src/analysis.py slope docstring (Gate 1 re-review N1; third re-read M3)

killed_paths.path: Shrink-then-regress player-level estimator for verdict condition 6
killed_paths.why_killed: DerSimonian-Laird tau2 clips to zero at ~32 decisions/player, every shrunk value equals the pooled mean, slope is zero to machine precision; failed on the planted C6 gradient in 6 of 6 simulated runs. Verdict reads raw inverse-variance-weighted per-player estimates; shrinkage kept for figures only.
killed_paths.where: MODEL_SPEC.md §7 (Gate 1 third re-read M4); src/estimands.py player_level

killed_paths.path: opponent_rating in the T0 context block
killed_paths.why_killed: Lichess pairs by rating so opponent_rating ~ rating; carrying it put the exposure inside the 'rating-free' models; Metric A would be identified from rating-difference variation only and Metric D would compare bands on a quantity already partialled out. Replaced by rating_diff; opponent_rating recorded but in no model.

killed_paths.path: Accepting both sides of one game as two observations
killed_paths.why_killed: Alternate plies of one position sequence with coupled clocks; dependence graph becomes player-game rather than the tree move in game in player; band intervals too narrow, worst in thin bands. At most ONE analysed side per game.

killed_paths.path: Single-permutation destructive controls with a player-bootstrap interval around the draw
killed_paths.why_killed: That interval measures how precisely one shuffled dataset was estimated, not whether the value is consistent with zero; produced five spurious 'failures' on VALIDATION. Replaced by 200 permutations, 2.5/97.5 percentile across permutations, MC SE and null-SD offset printed.

killed_paths.path: C3 construction permuting rating and recomputing rating_diff and rating_band through the frozen models
killed_paths.why_killed: A 900 player handed a 2400 rating acquires rating_diff -1500 -- impossible matchups evaluated by models never fitted near them; systematic offsets (+0.00195 Metric D, +0.00347 Metric C on DEV) no re-drawing would fix.

killed_paths.path: C3 construction perm_resid = perm_rating - ratinghat
killed_paths.why_killed: Leaves the deterministic term -cov(y_resid, ratinghat)/[var(rating)+var(ratinghat)], zero only on the fitting period; fired INVALID_EXPERIMENT on FINAL at 2.51 null SDs. Repaired to perm_resid = perm_rating.

killed_paths.path: C4 permuting the raw voc_z column as the pass condition
killed_paths.why_killed: Leaves -vochat(x) in place, which carries rating structure; null excluded zero on the fitting period itself (-0.00115, 3.3 SD on DEV). Pass condition now permutes voc_resid; raw-column value reported beside it as the recognition-channel term.

killed_paths.path: C7 generating quality around its mean (instead of Q0) and time from T1P
killed_paths.why_killed: q_resid retained -Qhat0(x); pipeline correctly reported a real association in a badly specified null (beta +0.0018 vs +0.0003 after fixing the quality generator alone). Now T2P time + Q0 quality + independent noise.

killed_paths.path: C5 as the control that makes a negative verdict meaningful
killed_paths.why_killed: Plants a term linear in the estimator's own regressor; recovery is linear algebra; can only fail on a code bug. Reclassified as an implementation check; C5b (foreign GBT residual) does that work.

killed_paths.path: C9 pass condition 'same sign under both budgets'
killed_paths.why_killed: Under A2 beta is positive at every budget and shrinks as difficulty is measured better; a sign test passes while the central limitation goes unfalsified. Replaced by r_beta ratio with threshold 0.5 on the upper bound.

killed_paths.path: Ambiguity temperature tau = 0.10 and near-band 0.05 (round numbers)
killed_paths.why_killed: Median best-to-second gap is 0.013 win probability, so entropy saturated at log(4) for half the corpus and n_near sat at 4. Both constants set to ACCURATE_WIN_PROBABILITY_LOSS = 0.02761 (borrowed, not chosen). Disclosed as a constant changed after a development smoke sample was looked at, before any feature-outcome relationship existed.

killed_paths.path: voc_rank Spearman using each move's position in its own full ordering
killed_paths.why_killed: Not a permutation of 0..n-1 when memberships differ; produced values up to 4.75 on a scale whose max is 2. Ranks now re-derived inside the common subset.

killed_paths.path: Reading the last search iteration as 'the engine's opinion'
killed_paths.why_killed: Node limit stops mid-iteration; partial set may hold lines 2..K without line 1 (KeyError, or silently reading line 2 as best). Pre-move search counts only full MultiPV sets; post-move search takes the deepest iteration carrying line 1.

killed_paths.path: A SAN-describing regex tokenizer; and parse_san without stripping ?/?!/! annotation suffixes
killed_paths.why_killed: First silently dropped plain pawn pushes (shifting every ply index); second dropped 10.7% of sampled sides non-randomly (games somebody had run computer analysis on). Tokenizer is now subtractive and strips suffixes.

killed_paths.path: Rated-ness from the Event header string
killed_paths.why_killed: B2's rule mislabelled a third of its corpus; B3 reads rated structurally from WhiteRatingDiff/BlackRatingDiff.

killed_paths.path: Frozen 180+0 nuisance models applied to 300+0 as a cross-context replication
killed_paths.why_killed: Extrapolation artefact: predicted log-time to -7.35, residual sd 5x, beta equals its destroyed-outcome null. Block declared NOT EVALUABLE.

killed_paths.path: Centipawns as the unit of any reported effect
killed_paths.why_killed: 30 cp costs 2.76 pp of winning chances at level and 0.28 pp at +10.00; a centipawn is not one thing. All evaluations converted to win probability (K = 0.00368208).

killed_paths.path: Naming engine search-instability features (best_move_changes, eval_volatility, pv_instability, nodes_to_depth10) as human cognitive complexity; naming unexpected_time as confusion/hesitation
killed_paths.why_killed: They measure how hard a position is for THIS engine at THIS budget; unexpected_time is a regression residual of a clock difference. Neutral names enforced throughout.

killed_paths.path: 'Five independent readings' of the Metric B null
killed_paths.why_killed: Pooled, T=0-removed, low-clock-pressure and player-level readings are one instrument on overlapping rows; the matched reading is degenerate.

killed_paths.path: Python hash()-salted control seeds
killed_paths.why_killed: Per-process salt made every permutation/C6/C7/C7b draw unregenerable. Replaced by blake2b(SEED|tag) (Gate 2 R1).

utilities.what_it_does: C1-C8, C7b, C5b, C10-C14, C17-C19 constructions; 200 permutations per destructive control, blake2b-seeded; _null returns {point, lo, hi, sd, mc_se, sd_units_from_zero, permutations, note}. (Read only in part.)

utilities.name: evaluate.py
utilities.what_it_does: Transcription of VERDICT_RULES.md: BETA_FLOOR 0.002, TAE_FLOOR 0.02, MONOTONE_RHO 0.6, SIGN_AGREEMENT 0.80, MIN_POWERED_BANDS 5, CENSOR_LIMIT 0.15, R2_GAIN_FLOOR 0.001, PLAYER_INFLUENCE_LIMIT 0.25, JACKKNIFE_LIMIT 0.20, C5B_RECOVERY_FLOOR 0.5, R_BETA_THRESHOLD 0.5; REQUIRED_CONTROLS; ordered gates INVALID_EXPERIMENT -> DIFFICULTY_PROXY_ONLY -> EXPERTISE_ADAPTATION_SUPPORTED -> GENERAL_REGULARITY_ONLY -> ADAPTATION_WITHOUT_REGULARITY -> SKILL_ONLY with exactly-one assertion; level ladder 0-5; C9 cap.

NOT read in this pass.

utilities.name: tests

utilities.name: sf-wasm.sh

features.name: ply
features.definition: 0-based ply index of the decision (even = White to move).
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: None. Board-only.

features.name: move_number
features.definition: Full-move number from the pre-move board.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: None.

features.name: phase
features.definition: 'endgame' if non-pawn material (both sides, N=B=3,R=5,Q=9) <= 13; else 'opening' if ply <= 20; else 'middlegame'. Repo rule (shared/phase.ts).
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: Heuristic; named as such wherever a claim is scoped by it.

features.name: non_pawn_material
features.definition: Sum over both sides of piece values N=B=3, R=5, Q=9 (pawns and kings 0).
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: None.

features.name: legal_moves
features.definition: Count of legal moves in the pre-move position (board.legal_moves.count()). Decisions with <= 1 are excluded as forced.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: None. Frozen DEV tercile cuts [28, 36].

features.name: in_check
features.definition: Side to move is in check (board.is_check()).
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: None. Categorical in T1.

features.name: standing
features.definition: From E1_before (pre-move best-line cp): 'winning' if >= +100 cp, 'losing' if <= -100 cp, else 'level'.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: Engine-derived from the pre-move search only. Note quality_loss is bounded by wp1_before so beta scales with standing (REPORT §4.4).

features.name: side / side_num
features.definition: Analysed player's colour; side_num = 1 if 'w' else 0.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: None.

features.name: is_book
features.definition: Pre-move position's 32-bit FNV-1a key over the four position-determining FEN fields is in the frozen 833-key opening book built from the 2026-03 dump (disjoint from all B3 periods).
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: Book positions kept in the primary analysis; removed in C11 (beta +0.01385 without them). Book share 5.5%.

features.name: wp1
features.definition: Win probability for the side to move of the engine's best line at the final complete iteration: 1/(1+exp(-0.00368208*cp)), mate = +/-10000 cp. Search: Stockfish 17.1, go nodes 60000, MultiPV 4, Threads 1, Hash 32, ucinewgame before every search.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: Shared exactly with quality_loss (= wp1 - (1 - wp1_after)), so the two share the same deep evaluation noise (Gate 1 disclosure 7). Win-probability curve fitted by Lichess on 2300-rated games; population-dependent. Frozen DEV quintile cuts [0.3385, 0.4945, 0.5605, 0.7552].

features.name: edge
features.definition: abs(wp1 - 0.5): how decided the position already is.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: None beyond wp1's.

features.name: gap12
features.definition: wp1 - wp2 (win-probability units): cost of playing the second-best move. 0.5 if only one line.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: Frozen DEV tercile cuts [0.006369, 0.025498]. Median best-to-second gap ~0.013.

features.name: gap1k
features.definition: wp1 - wpK, K = 4 (or the last available line).
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: A censored voc_regret EQUALS gap1k (Gate 1 disclosure 16).

features.name: ambiguity_entropy
features.definition: Shannon entropy (nats) of softmax(wp_k / tau) over the K lines, tau = ACCURATE_WIN_PROBABILITY_LOSS = 0.02761. Max log(4) = 1.386.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: Temperature borrowed from the repo's accuracy threshold (F4: tau 0.10 saturated). Frozen DEV tercile cuts [0.99606, 1.32332]. Enters the interaction ambiguity_entropy x clock_pressure in T2.

features.name: n_near
features.definition: Count of the K lines within ACCURATE_WIN_PROBABILITY_LOSS (0.02761) win probability of the best -- moves as good as the best by the study's own outcome definition. Transformation-free alternative to entropy.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: None.

features.name: best_move_changes
features.definition: Number of times the depth-1 principal move changed across completed (full-MultiPV) iterations of the pre-move search.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: ENGINE search complexity, never human cognitive complexity. voc_switch is built from the same iteration history (Gate 1 R1c).

features.name: eval_volatility
features.definition: Standard deviation of wp1 across completed iterations from depth 4 onward.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: Engine complexity. voc_drift shares its iteration history. Matched-sample SMD worsened +0.174 -> +0.284.

features.name: pv_instability
features.definition: Mean normalised Hamming distance between the depth-d and depth-d+1 principal variations over their common prefix length, averaged over iterations.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: Engine complexity.

features.name: final_depth
features.definition: Depth of the last completed iteration (median ~12 at 60k nodes, ~14 at 150k).
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: Scale moves with node budget (C9 refits per budget).

features.name: nodes_to_depth10 (+ nodes_to_depth10_missing)
features.definition: Nodes reported at the first iteration reaching depth >= 10; null if never reached (indicator column; imputed with frozen DEV median 20601).
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: Engine complexity.

features.name: is_mate_line
features.definition: Best line is a forced mate (score kind 'mate').
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: None.

features.name: voc_switch
features.definition: 1 if the best move at the shallow iteration (last completed iteration with depth <= D_SHALLOW = 8) differs from the final best move.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes (as a feature); NOT as an allocation instrument
features.leakage_notes: Reads only the pre-move search trace. Budget-unstable. Slope of residual time on it +0.0075 (FINAL).

features.name: voc_regret (+ voc_regret_censored, voc_z)
features.definition: PRIMARY VoC: wp_deep(best_deep) - wp_deep(best_shallow), clipped to [0, 0.5]; if best_shallow is not among the final K lines its deep value is taken as wpK (lower bound) and the row flagged censored (10.2-10.3% per period; gate 15%). voc_z = (voc_regret - 0.0081855)/0.0191501 (frozen DEV mean/sd). Zero when shallow == final best.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes as a feature; killed as the instrument for Time Allocation Efficiency
features.admissible_for_validation: with caution: 59.4% point mass at zero; corr across budgets 0.64
features.leakage_notes: Anchored on the same deep evaluation as quality_loss (shared wp1_before). Frozen DEV tercile cuts [0.0, 0.003767]. Matching on its terciles selects the point mass.

features.name: voc_drift
features.definition: abs(wp_deep(E1) - wp_shallow(E1)).
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: Shares iteration history with eval_volatility.

features.name: voc_rank
features.definition: 1 - Spearman rho between the shallow and final orderings of moves present in both lists (ranks re-derived in the common subset); 0 when fewer than 3 common moves.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: Budget correlation only 0.49.

features.name: clock_ms_self
features.definition: The analysed player's clock as they began the decision: clk[i-2] x 1000 (the reading written after their previous move).
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: Must NOT be taken from clk[i] (test_suffix_leakage enforces). 5 interior spline knots. Frozen 180+0 knots do not extrapolate to 300+0.

features.name: clock_ms_opp
features.definition: Opponent's clock at the same instant: clk[i-1] x 1000.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: None.

features.name: clock_frac
features.definition: clock_ms_self / (1000 x base_seconds).
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: Wrong for berserked games (excluded).

features.name: clock_pressure
features.definition: -log(clock_frac + 0.01); increases as the clock empties.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: Frozen DEV tercile cuts [0.12531, 0.63069]; enters both T2 interactions; C14 strata.

features.name: clock_diff_frac
features.definition: (clock_ms_self - clock_ms_opp) / (1000 x base_seconds).
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: None.

features.name: opp_prev_think_s (+ opp_prev_think_missing)
features.definition: Seconds the OPPONENT spent on ply i-1: clk_opp[i-3] - clk_opp[i-1] + increment; null (with indicator) when the opponent's previous move was their first; imputed with frozen DEV median 2.0. Required in T0 (Gate 1 R9).
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: Closes the thinking-on-the-opponent's-clock route to a false-positive beta (A12). Beta by opponent previous think: 0.0086 (<1 s), 0.0116, 0.0163, 0.0152 (>= 8 s) (Gate 3 §2.1).

features.name: own_prev_think_s (+ own_prev_think_missing)
features.definition: Seconds the player spent on their own previous move: clk[i-4] - clk[i-2] + increment; null for ply < 4. Recorded; in NO primary model (absorbs pace = part of the allocation policy); control C19 adds it (beta +0.01345).
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes for a player-specific pace/tempo signal (explicitly a policy component)
features.leakage_notes: Pre-move by construction.

features.name: rating / rating_band / rating_diff / opponent_rating
features.definition: Analysed side's rating at game time; band of width 200 over [800, 2600); rating_diff = rating - opponent_rating (in T0); opponent_rating recorded but in NO model.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes (rating_diff); rating only in models named R
features.leakage_notes: opponent_rating is a near-proxy for rating (Lichess pairing) -- excluded (Gate 1 R5). Rating deviation not in dump.

features.name: seconds_taken (T) / log_time (Y)
features.definition: T = clk[i-2] - clk[i] + increment, whole seconds, must satisfy 0 <= T <= base_seconds; Y = log(1 + T), the primary time representation. T = 0 means 'under one second' (9.7-10.0% of decisions; 5.6% in 800-999 to 14.6% in 2400-2599).
features.admissible_for_discovery: as a BEHAVIOURAL OUTCOME of the decision (what the player did), never as a predictor of itself; listed in PRE_MOVE tuple in code but FEATURE_SCHEMA §8 says 'PRE_MOVE as an outcome, never as a predictor of itself'
features.admissible_for_validation: as an outcome / conditioning variable known at move commit time
features.leakage_notes: Reads clk[i], the reading written AFTER the move; the only non-outcome column permitted to change under the suffix-leakage test. Whole-second granularity (+/-1 s incl. lag compensation).

features.name: unexpected_time_population / unexpected_time_within_rating / unexpected_time_novoc
features.definition: Y - Yhat(T2P) [rating excluded]; Y - Yhat(T2R) [rating included]; Y - Yhat(T1P) [no rating, no VoC; Metric C only]. Frozen DEV ridge-spline fits.
features.admissible_for_discovery: as the study's key derived behavioural signal: 'a regression residual of a clock difference' -- computable for any 180+0 decision from the frozen models once T is known
features.admissible_for_validation: yes as an outcome-side quantity; forbidden names: confusion, hesitation, indecision, cognitive state
features.leakage_notes: Depends on T (post-commit). Frozen models drift out of period and do not extrapolate to 300+0. Extreme indicator: extreme_ut = 1[UT_pop > ut_q95 = 1.057224] (frozen DEV 95th percentile).

features.name: ut_resid, q_resid, y_resid_T1, rating_resid, voc_resid, allocation_loss, overthinking, premature_commitment, extreme_ut, allocation_resid, extreme_resid
features.definition: FWL companions: ut_resid = UT_within - UThat(T2R design); q_resid = quality_loss - Qhat0; y_resid_T1 = Y - Yhat(T1P); rating_resid = rating - ratinghat(T1P); voc_resid = voc_z - vochat(T1P); allocation_loss = |U| x 1[sign(U) != sign(voc_z)] with U = UT_novoc; overthinking = U if U>0 & voc_z<0; premature_commitment = -U if U<0 & voc_z>0; extreme_ut as above; allocation_resid/extreme_resid = residuals against frozen T1P fits.
features.admissible_for_discovery: population-analysis internals; q_resid is POST_MOVE
features.leakage_notes: q_resid, allocation_loss etc. read outcomes.

features.name: trace (search_trace)
features.definition: Compact record of the whole iterative deepening: trace_depths, trace_wp1, trace_nodes, top_wps, top_moves, shallow_depth, shallow_wps, shallow_moves, nodes_total. NOT a feature; no model reads it.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes -- raw material for alternative difficulty/VoC summaries (e.g. B4's expected regret) without re-scoring
features.admissible_for_validation: yes if the summary is frozen before use
features.leakage_notes: Pre-move search only.

features.name: quality_loss [POST_MOVE]
features.definition: wp1_before - (1 - wp1_after), clipped at 0; wp1_after = best line of the post-move search from the opponent's view (deepest iteration carrying line 1); checkmate -> mover wp 1.0; stalemate/insufficient -> 0.5; both searches identical settings. Units: win probability [0,1].
features.admissible_for_discovery: TARGET only
features.leakage_notes: Unreachable from any model feature list (test_leakage). Bounded by wp1_before. When the played move is the engine's best, the loss is pure depth asymmetry between two searches.

features.name: accurate [POST_MOVE]
features.definition: quality_loss <= ACCURATE_WIN_PROBABILITY_LOSS = 0.027608582058630926 (what 30 cp costs at a level position, evaluated at cp_loss/2). B2-compatible binary; used only for C10 (logistic beta on inaccuracy +0.0672 [+0.0610, +0.0732]).
features.admissible_for_discovery: TARGET only
features.leakage_notes: Same definition as shared/detector.ts (test_ports).

features.name: move_uci, wp_after, fen_before [POST_MOVE / identity]
features.definition: The played move; mover's win probability after the move; the pre-move FEN (kept for re-scoring).
features.admissible_for_discovery: move_uci only for post-hoc diagnostics (engine-best split); fen_before is pre-move identity
features.leakage_notes: move_uci is POST_MOVE and no model may read it.

target_definitions.name: quality_loss (primary outcome)
target_definitions.definition: quality_loss = max(0, wp1_before - (1 - wp1_after)), where wp = 1/(1+exp(-0.00368208 x cp)), mate = +/-10000 cp; wp1_before from the pre-move search's last full-MultiPV iteration, wp1_after from the post-move search's deepest iteration carrying line 1 (opponent to move); checkmate -> wp_after_for_mover 1.0, stalemate/insufficient material -> 0.5, otherwise unscoreable -> decision dropped. Engine: Stockfish 17.1 x86-64-avx2 (sha256 7fecbc0b...), go nodes 60000, MultiPV 4, Threads 1, Hash 32 MB, ucinewgame + isready before every search.
target_definitions.thresholds: Continuous, [0,1]. Mean 0.0488/0.0500/0.0501 (DEV/VAL/FINAL). Blunder-decomposition caps used diagnostically: 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5. Standing strata: beta/sd(q_resid) ~0.18-0.21.

target_definitions.name: accurate (B2-compatible binary)
target_definitions.definition: 1[quality_loss <= ACCURATE_WIN_PROBABILITY_LOSS], ACCURATE_WIN_PROBABILITY_LOSS = win_probability(15) - win_probability(-15) = 0.027608582058630926 (30 cp at a level position). Used only in C10.

target_definitions.name: beta (H1 primary estimand)
target_definitions.definition: Coefficient of unexpected_time_within_rating in Q1: quality_loss ~ [T2 feature set] + rating + beta x UT_within, computed by FWL as the centred slope cov(q_resid, ut_resid)/var(ut_resid) on frozen DEV residuals. Units: win probability per unit log(1+T).
target_definitions.thresholds: H1 holds iff beta > 0 AND 95% player-bootstrap interval (400 replicates) excludes 0 AND beta >= BETA_FLOOR = 0.002. Level 2 requires Q1 - Q0 held-out R2 >= 0.001. Level 3 requires ceil(0.80 x N_powered) sign agreement of RAW band betas across >= 5 adequately powered bands (>= 150 players AND >= 3,000 decisions).

target_definitions.name: Metric A: matched-difficulty thinking time
target_definitions.definition: 100 x slope(y_resid_T1, rating_resid): log-seconds per 100 Elo, holding T1P difficulty features fixed.
target_definitions.thresholds: Expected negative; directional only (interval excludes 0 with the expected sign); no band shape requirement.

target_definitions.name: Metric B: Time Allocation Efficiency (H2 primary)
target_definitions.definition: Within band b, gamma_b = cov(eY, eV | b)/var(eV | b) with eY = Y - Yhat(T1P), eV = voc_z - vochat(T1P); continuous gradient = coefficient of eV x rating_c in eY ~ s(rating) + eV + eV x rating_c (rating_c in hundreds of Elo centred at 1600; s(rating) frozen-knot spline). Units: log-seconds per DEV sd of VoC, per 100 Elo.
target_definitions.thresholds: Expected positive; interval excludes 0; band Spearman >= MONOTONE_RHO 0.6; must hold four times over (matched sample, T = 0 removed [C17], lowest clock-pressure tercile [C14 t0]) and spread TAE(highest band) - TAE(lowest) >= TAE_FLOOR = 0.02 with interval excluding 0; player-level inverse-variance regression same sign excluding 0 (players with >= 20 decisions); player-disjoint restriction must repeat conditions 1 and 5.

target_definitions.name: Metric C: Allocation Loss (descriptive)
target_definitions.definition: AllocationLoss_i = |U_i| x 1[sign(U_i) != sign(voc_z_i)], U = unexpected_time_novoc; band mean and 100 x slope(allocation_resid, rating_resid).
target_definitions.thresholds: Expected negative; CANNOT count toward a verdict (transform of Metric B).

target_definitions.name: Metric D: extreme unexpected-time exposure
target_definitions.definition: extreme_ut = 1[unexpected_time_population > ut_q95], ut_q95 = 1.057224263312421 (frozen DEV 95th percentile); band rate and 100 x slope(extreme_resid, rating_resid) (linear probability, pp per 100 Elo).
target_definitions.thresholds: Expected negative; interval excludes 0; band Spearman <= -0.6.

target_definitions.name: Metric E: friction burden (descriptive)
target_definitions.definition: E_b = E[q_resid | extreme_ut, b] - E[q_resid | not extreme, b].
target_definitions.thresholds: No directional prediction; cannot contribute.

target_definitions.name: Verdict gates and control thresholds
target_definitions.definition: Ordered gates: INVALID_EXPERIMENT (leakage fail; C5 fail; C5b recovered_fraction < 0.5; C6 planted gradient not recovered; C7 reports a gradient; any of C1-C4 excludes 0; holdout contaminated; DEV voc censoring > 0.15; engine nondeterminism) -> DIFFICULTY_PROXY_ONLY ((interval(beta) contains 0 OR |beta| < 0.002) AND Q1-Q0 R2 < 0.001) -> EXPERTISE_ADAPTATION_SUPPORTED (all 18 checks) -> GENERAL_REGULARITY_ONLY (H1 holds) -> ADAPTATION_WITHOUT_REGULARITY -> SKILL_ONLY. C8: beta within +/-25% without busiest 1% of players; no single player shifts beta > 20%. C9: if upper bound of r_beta < 0.5, level capped at 2. C5: planted 0.02 recovered within 30%.
target_definitions.thresholds: BETA_FLOOR 0.002; TAE_FLOOR 0.02; MONOTONE_RHO 0.6; SIGN_AGREEMENT 0.80 (ceil); MIN_POWERED_BANDS 5; CENSOR_LIMIT 0.15; R2_GAIN_FLOOR 0.001; PLAYER_INFLUENCE_LIMIT 0.25; JACKKNIFE_LIMIT 0.20; C5B_RECOVERY_FLOOR 0.5; R_BETA_THRESHOLD 0.5; adequately powered band >= 150 players AND >= 3,000 decisions.

target_definitions.name: Decision eligibility
target_definitions.definition: Player's move; think time derivable (clock at ply i-2 exists); 0 <= T <= base_seconds; more than one legal move; not the last ply; board legal. Game: rated (RatingDiff present), Standard, TimeControl exactly 180+0 (or 300+0), %clk on every ply, not berserk, ratings in [600,3000], no BOT title, Termination in {Normal, Time forfeit}, >= 20 plies, parses. Side: rating in [800,2600). Caps: 1 side per game, 2 sides per player per period, 60 decisions per side (evenly spaced). Account not disabled/tosViolation at lookup.
target_definitions.thresholds: As listed.

relevance_to_mission: B3 is POPULATION evidence (2,331-2,428 independent Lichess players per period, at most 2 games each) and contains no analysis of the owner (erez281) beyond the byte-identical reproduction of B2's 117-game corpus in b2_repro/. What it gives the mission: (1) a leakage-tested, deterministic PRE-MOVE feature vocabulary (position, engine-difficulty, engine search-complexity, VoC, clock, opponent-previous-think) with exact formulas, frozen constants and two enforced leakage tests (played-move swap and game-suffix replacement) -- directly reusable as the admissible input set for a player-specific mechanism; (2) a target definition in win-probability units (quality_loss) with the B2-compatible 'accurate' cut 0.02761, plus a demonstration that quality_loss is only ~16-17% predictable (R2) from pre-move features at population level and that unexpected time adds 0.009; (3) a population regularity that an unusually long think (residual of log(1+T) against position/clock/rating) predicts blunders (beta +0.0134; 3/4 carried by losses > 0.05; positive within-player and within-game as point estimates), which is a candidate POPULATION prior for one mechanism family ('long-think blunders') but is explicitly NOT a mechanism, NOT causal, NOT cognition, and carries an unexcluded human-perceived-difficulty alternative (A2); (4) an explicit instrument null: the engine shallow-vs-deep 'value of computation' features are degenerate (59% zero mass, 1.7% partial correlation, budget reliability 0.62) and must not be read as 'how much thinking this position deserved'; (5) baseline ladders (T0/T1P/T2P/T2R/GBT; Q0/Q1) and control designs (permutation nulls as code checks, planted-signal C5b/C6, player-influence C8, budget C9, T=0 exclusion C17, first-40-plies C18, own-pace C19) that the mission's L2/L3 steps can copy. What it cannot say about one player: MODEL_CARD §3 forbids judging an individual from these models ('roughly thirty decisions behind each'); per-player TAE vs rating is null; the within-player beta is a population average without an interval; the frozen nuisance models drift across months, were fitted on a Sunday 180+0 population, and do not extrapolate to 300+0 (the owner's B2 corpus includes 25 x 300+0 and 8 x 300+3 games); think time is a post-commit behavioural signal (reads clk[i]), so any 'unexpected time' feature is admissible as what the player DID, not as pre-decision information; the engine lineage differs from the product's (Stockfish 17.1 native 60k nodes vs Stockfish 18 Lite WASM depth 12).
contradictions: verdict.json: "verdict": "INVALID_EXPERIMENT", "level": null, reasons ["C3 failed: shuffled rating reproduced metric_a_time_vs_rating"] VERSUS verdict_repaired.json: "verdict": "GENERAL_REGULARITY_ONLY", "level": 3 -- same estimates, same 18 checks, same 7 failed conditions; reconciled by amendment A7 (post-holdout C3 repair), both printed by rule A7.11.

Both verdict files carry "label_means": "the time / value-of-computation relation differs systematically with rating, net of matched position and clock state -- NOT that expertise changes how players manage the process (VERDICT_RULES.md 3.1)" -- which is the definition of EXPERTISE_ADAPTATION_SUPPORTED (level 4), a verdict neither file records.
