features.name: secondsTaken (think time)
features.definition: Seconds between the previous own move and this move (import: derived from clock differences, whole seconds; live: measured at commit). null when underivable (player's first move) — never 0.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes (shipped bucket fast-under-45s / slow-over-2m; both structurally dead on blitz: owner record 45,883 vs 4)
features.leakage_notes: Confounded with position difficulty (population blunder rate rises 1.55%→7.92% with think time). A 0-fill fabricated fast-bucket decisions (fixed, GATE-MEASURE).

features.name: clockMsRemaining
features.definition: 'the clock as the player FACED it' — remaining clock before the move; bucket clock-under-1m: < 60,000 ms; null-safe.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: Time class differs (45 s is most of a 3+0 game); clock buckets read only the dominant time class of an import.
features.where_defined: shared/detector.ts; docs/MEASUREMENTS.md 'Which time class a decision came from'

features.name: phase
features.definition: classifyPhase(fenBefore, ply): endgame if non-pawn material ≤ 13 (ENDGAME_MATERIAL_THRESHOLD), opening if ply ≤ OPENING_MAX_PLY = 20, else middlegame. Read on the position BEFORE the move; server re-derives from the entry FEN and refuses a disagreeing client label.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes (three shipped buckets)
features.leakage_notes: Documented heuristic, not a fact; reading the post-move FEN diverges one-directionally into endgame on capture.

features.name: standing (winning / level / losing)
features.definition: Engine eval of the position the player faced, evalScores[ply − 1], boundary ±1 pawn (100 cp).
features.admissible_for_discovery: import-only (IMPORT_BUCKETINGS), 'deliberately unable to produce a claim'; only the six shared buckets are registrable
features.admissible_for_validation: no on the live loop (R3 forbids the engine speaking before commit)
features.leakage_notes: Pre-move information but engine-derived; unavailable to the live record by design.
features.where_defined: shared/import-diagnostic.ts IMPORT_BUCKETINGS; docs/MEASUREMENTS.md 'The import reads two things the live record cannot'

features.name: confidence (1..7 → .05 .20 .35 .50 .65 .80 .95)
features.definition: Stated before any engine output (GATE-COMMIT); stored with confidence_scale and confidence_grid_version.
features.admissible_for_discovery: NO — 'Confidence is half the gap, so it is also not a selector' (D04); the first search version found 'confidence < 5' as a restated target
features.admissible_for_validation: it is half of the primary outcome (calibration gap)
features.leakage_notes: Live loop only; imported games carry none.

features.name: known.tapped / known.typed, unknown.tapped / unknown.typed (reading chips)
features.definition: Ten reading chips (≥1 required) and seven cannot-assess chips (≥1 required) plus free text, declared before the engine speaks.
features.admissible_for_discovery: not declared under any FeatureSpec I read; Neta Pass 3 proposes counting them ('reading X chosen in 3 decisions') as a count-not-claim surface
features.leakage_notes: Live loop only; memory/owner-language.yaml is 'a prior, not truth'.

features.name: candidate_moves_considered (up to 8), decision (move_uci)
features.definition: Moves the player placed on the board before committing; the committed move.
features.admissible_for_discovery: not declared; the committed move itself is the observation being judged
features.leakage_notes: Live loop only.

features.name: probe: assignment (probed / not-probed / ineligible), legal_moves, alternative, answered, alternative_cp_loss
features.definition: Randomised counterfactual question after the reveal ('what would you have played instead') with legal_moves as covariate; assignment recorded on every decision.
features.admissible_for_discovery: assignment/legal_moves are pre-reveal covariates; alternative_cp_loss is post-engine
features.leakage_notes: Illegal alternative was once accepted and written with cpLoss null (fixed).
features.where_defined: shared/decision-atom.ts; PRE_HUMAN_UX_PASS_2_3_4.md Pass 4; user-loop FALSIFICATION_REGISTER C9

features.name: accurate / cp_loss / engine_eval_cp / engine_best_move / engine_depth / engine_build / engine_source
features.definition: TARGET and its engine provenance; accurate = winProbabilityLoss(eval, cpLoss) ≤ 2.76.
features.admissible_for_discovery: NEVER as a predictor — 'A target may never describe a subgroup'
features.leakage_notes: cutoff for predictors is the commit; 'everything between them — the engine's verdict most of all — is exactly what a predictor may not contain'.

features.name: book position
features.definition: Position reached by ≥ 0.1% of 73,279 reference Lichess games within the first 30 plies (833 positions; FNV-1a 32-bit key over positionKey, 0 collisions). Claim about the position, never the move.
features.admissible_for_discovery: used as an exclusion (owner: 6,213 of 59,419)
features.leakage_notes: Engine-independent (identical 7.8% on both engines).
features.where_defined: docs/MEASUREMENTS.md 'What excluding book positions did to the rate'

features.name: forced (single legal move)
features.definition: Exactly one legal move; excluded from every bucket and reported separately (owner: 325).
features.admissible_for_discovery: exclusion
features.leakage_notes: Recaptures with a legal alternative and 'practically forced' positions are still counted (needs MultiPV, B3 unmeasured).
features.where_defined: docs/MEASUREMENTS.md 'Excluding positions that offered no choice'

features.name: time class / speed (blitz, rapid, bullet, ultrabullet, classical) and measurement_protocol
features.definition: Game-level eligibility features.
features.admissible_for_discovery: NO — VALIDATION_ONLY: 'decide eligibility and never membership'; a subgroup described by protocol is one regime evidence-policy refuses to pool
features.leakage_notes: Owner record is 1,899/2,209 blitz; clock buckets read only the dominant class.

features.name: game_id, ply
features.definition: Carried on DecisionAtom; game_id dropped by scoreDecisions before the detector; D04's vocabulary has no game or ply selector ('one-game-only' and 'every-game-first-moves' worlds stay at 0.0000).
features.admissible_for_discovery: not in the fixed vocabulary; 'widening the vocabulary is a new multiplicity question, not a free improvement'
features.admissible_for_validation: game_id needed for derivation/validation game split (derivation_game_ids_hash)
features.leakage_notes: ICC estimation only (clustering.ts).

features.name: playerRelativeThinkPercentile
features.definition: Think time as a percentile of a player-specific reference distribution.
features.admissible_for_discovery: only with a reference not drawn from the decisions being read
features.leakage_notes: 'a reference drawn from the same decisions being read is leakage wearing a percentile'; recomputation is a new observation with a later observed_at.

features.name: DeepGameFeatures (totalMoves, gameLength, result, castlingSpeed, PhaseFeatures, ~20 more)
features.definition: Computed by replaying the whole game.
features.admissible_for_discovery: NO (post-game with respect to every decision inside it)
features.leakage_notes: No consumers; 'one import away' from leakage; declare with FeatureSpec or delete.

features.name: candidate predicate atoms named in tests: clockShare, materialAdvantage (e.g. 'clockShare < 0.37 AND materialAdvantage > 1')
features.definition: Illustrative conjunction atoms used to show why a name cannot carry a threshold; not shipped features.
features.admissible_for_discovery: only if declared in the fixed vocabulary before a run
features.leakage_notes: None stated.

features.name: system-invariant pre-move engine candidate features: candidates[{uci,wp}] (MultiPV 8), wp1, n_candidates, n_near, ambiguity_entropy, edge, gap12, gap1k, is_mate_line
features.definition: From a MultiPV-8 search of fen_before at 60,000 nodes (Stockfish 17.1): win-probability of the best and of each candidate; n_near = candidates within a margin of the best; entropy over candidate wp; edge/gap12/gap1k = differences between the top candidates (exact formulas in docs/system-invariant/RESEARCH_QUESTION_FREEZE.md, not read in full).
features.admissible_for_discovery: population study only so far; engine-derived so unavailable to the live loop under R3, but available for imported/historical decisions
features.leakage_notes: quality_loss, wp1_after, post_terminal in the same row are POST-move and must not be predictors.

features.name: OwnExposure (own_overloaded_piece_count) pre / post / delta, plus P3 48-column system_state and negative controls own_redundantly_defended_count, own_max_defense_dependency, own_king_ring_own_defenses
features.definition: Count of the mover's own non-king pieces with strictly more enemy attackers than own defenders (raw counts, pins not special-cased, pawns included); pre = before the move, post = after board.push(move), delta = post − pre; no engine information.
features.admissible_for_discovery: board-only; 'Everything here is computable at the board'; population verdict in docs/system-invariant/NATURAL_GENERALIZATION.md (not read)
features.leakage_notes: post/delta require a candidate move but no engine; computable for any candidate before commit.

features.name: local_move_descriptors: moving_piece_type, capture_flag, captured_piece_value, promotion_piece_type, from/to file/rank, chebyshev_distance, manhattan_distance, gives_check; plus material_balance, piece_count, mobility_own/opp (post)
features.definition: Geometry and tactical surface of a (position, candidate move) pair; board-only.

target_definitions.name: accuracy rate (canonical)
target_definitions.definition: share of decisions with winProbabilityLoss(eval, cpLoss) = winProbability(eval) − winProbability(eval − cpLoss) ≤ ACCURATE_WIN_PROBABILITY_LOSS; logistic k = 0.00368208; ground truth in the instrument spec 'Stockfish 18, depth 14, MultiPV 8'; the canonical records were scored at depth 12 (Stockfish 18 Lite WASM, Threads 1, Hash 16, cleared) and 'the oracle charges nothing for its own best move' (single MultiPV root search).
target_definitions.thresholds: ACCURATE_WIN_PROBABILITY_LOSS = 2.76 points of winning chances (derived from ACCURATE_CP_LOSS = 30 at the evaluation where its cost peaks); ENGINE_NOISE_CP = 30 for a preference-vs-reason tie.
target_definitions.where_defined: shared/detector.ts, shared/win-probability.ts; docs/MEASUREMENTS.md 'Two things were called accuracy' and instrument §2

target_definitions.name: accuracy score (non-canonical)
target_definitions.definition: Lichess-style exponential 0–100 per move, averaged; display only inside GameReview, labelled 'ציון דיוק'; 'never enters a bucket'.
target_definitions.thresholds: none

target_definitions.name: calibration gap (primary product measure)
target_definitions.definition: gap = mean confidence − accuracy rate, bucketed by position class; positive = overconfidence. Per-decision quantity confidence − (accurate ? 1 : 0) whose mean is identically gap.
target_definitions.thresholds: reported only where both sides ≥ MIN_BUCKET_N = 30; cold start ~60–90 decisions.

target_definitions.name: separability (detector claim rule)
target_definitions.definition: A bucket is reported when |gap_inside − gap_outside| exceeds SEPARABILITY_K × sqrt(var_in/n_in + var_out/n_out) with Bessel-corrected variances of the per-decision quantity; both sides ≥ MIN_BUCKET_N.
target_definitions.thresholds: SEPARABILITY_K = 3.75 (scan of six), MIN_BUCKET_N = 30; pre-named bucket: n = 20 and k = 3.25 (MEASUREMENTS §5, D04) or k = 3.00 ('Pre-registration now buys the bar' table, 'shipped'); GATE-SHUFFLE ceiling 2% worst-cell false positive, measured 0.7%.

target_definitions.name: worst-bucket verdict (import)
target_definitions.definition: Lowest accurate rate among up to nine overlapping buckets vs the runner-up; separable if separation > 2 × sqrt(var_a + var_b) of two independent proportions.
target_definitions.thresholds: two standard errors (false-positive 0.7%, ceiling 2%); one SE refused (6.7%). Owner full record: separation 0.0062 vs threshold 0.0086 → not separable.

target_definitions.name: attribution veto
target_definitions.definition: Within the claimed bucket, split by each other bucketing; if some division carries the whole gap, withhold (never rename).
target_definitions.thresholds: ATTRIBUTION_K = 2.5; turn-on trigger 60 validation games.

target_definitions.name: D04 search rejection rule and on-target
target_definitions.definition: Rejected unless correct attribution improves WITHOUT the false-claim rate exceeding the ceiling; on-target = Jaccard(found region, planted region) ≥ 0.60 on the validation half; search on derivation half only, frozen, judged at shipped k and n.
target_definitions.thresholds: false-claim ceiling 0.02 (measured 0.0010); Jaccard ≥ 0.60.

target_definitions.name: D05 relative-time recovery bar
target_definitions.definition: Candidate bucket must recover a planted clean-fast effect at half the middlegame's on-target rate.
target_definitions.thresholds: bar 0.2112; measured 0.0000 and 0.0475 → REJECTED.

target_definitions.name: book / forced exclusions
target_definitions.definition: book: ≥ 0.1% of 73,279 reference games within 30 plies; forced: exactly one legal move.
target_definitions.thresholds: 833 book positions; owner: book 6,213, forced 325 of 59,419.

target_definitions.name: standing boundary
target_definitions.definition: winning / level / losing by engine eval of the position faced.
target_definitions.thresholds: ±1 pawn (100 cp).

target_definitions.name: transfer test success (learning)
target_definitions.definition: A position succeeds when recalled text clears scoreRecall's word-overlap floor AND accurateDecision (win-probability loss); a test is observed at TRANSFER_MINIMUM_SUCCESSES of TRANSFER_POSITION_COUNT; replicated/refuted on two distinct dates; applied_rule recorded, not a criterion.
target_definitions.thresholds: TRANSFER_MINIMUM_SUCCESSES = 2, TRANSFER_POSITION_COUNT = 3; RETRIEVAL_INTERVAL_DAYS = [1,3,7,21]; MIN_DRILL_POSITIONS = 5, MAX_DRILL_POSITIONS = 8 ('cannot decide anything').

target_definitions.name: Brier decomposition / AUROC2 / control
target_definitions.definition: BRIER = RELIABILITY − RESOLUTION + UNCERTAINTY grouped by level; sensitivity AUROC2 (shared/sensitivity.ts) read against 3,836-person bands conditioned on accuracy; control = Spearman of seconds vs stated confidence.
target_definitions.thresholds: population baseline floor 500 moves per side; sensitivity band floor 200 people; nothing reported below MIN_BUCKET_N per level.

target_definitions.name: STOP-B1 engine parity tolerance
target_definitions.definition: If the two engines disagree on more decisions than the product's own display resolution, re-tune nothing.
target_definitions.thresholds: T2 = 13.0 pp; measured Δ 13.6 pp, 13.61% verdict flips.

target_definitions.name: system-invariant move quality (population)
target_definitions.definition: MoveQuality ~ OwnExposure + Position/Context Controls + Player Strength + Game/Player Dependence; per-row quality_loss and wp1 − wp(move) from MultiPV-8 at 60,000 nodes (Stockfish 17.1).
target_definitions.thresholds: not read (docs/system-invariant/FALSIFIERS.md)

utilities.name: cache.py (key_for / lookup / index / --stats)

utilities.name: preserve.py
utilities.what_it_does: Turns action_set.py --raw rows into engine_evaluations.jsonl + item_bank.jsonl + MANIFEST.json; restores provenance by joining on (fen, rule_class, actor_elo, observable_action); reconstructs the seeded chance partition random.Random(f"{fen}|{len(B)}").

utilities.name: extract.py
utilities.what_it_does: Zero-engine re-read of the frozen corpus: action-set atlas, viability matrix, single-best-move audit, item-bank labels, failure ontology, natural-retest assets; natural() dedup rule.

utilities.name: gate_a.py
utilities.what_it_does: Gate A re-run: per-class cell stats plus pooled within-B regret distribution (per_action / per_item_max / per_item_p50), engine-sensitivity deltas against the published Stockfish 16 model; no new threshold.

utilities.name: gate_b.py
utilities.what_it_does: Paired T+ minus T- contrast over twin pairs (mean, sd, se, ci95, t, share_positive, share_zero); Q3 difficulty via v_star_xs_gap and prescription_size gap.

utilities.name: minimal_twins.py (covariates, legal_position, relocations, try_twin, promotion_square)
utilities.what_it_does: Builds RC-05 minimal functional twins by relocating one enemy piece; refusal rules enumerated; writes items in action_set.py format; covariates() is a reusable pre-move board-feature function.

utilities.name: sham_twins.py (try_sham)
utilities.what_it_does: Builds matched perturbation controls that keep the trigger state; prefers same piece and same Chebyshev distance as the real twin.

utilities.name: played_move_cost.py
utilities.what_it_does: regret_played = V*(s) - U(s, played) with both terms searched in one run (root_moves=[played] then full-width); is_mate() guard MATE_BAND 1000; expected_score() = (wins + draws/2)/total under sf16 WDL at the position's ply.

utilities.name: p3_system_invariant.py (system_state, side_piece_metrics, attack_edges, build_rows, loco_predict, pair_stats, bootstrap_diff)
utilities.what_it_does: Computes the 24 relational 'system' features of a board for a given actor colour, builds per-(position, candidate move) rows with regret target from the cache, LOCO Ridge fits, within-position pairwise accuracy with position-cluster bootstrap. focal_square() uses rule_classes._designated_threat(board).

utilities.name: p4_n1_prepare.py

utilities.name: pressure_exposure_test.py / pressure_exposure_diagnostic.py

utilities.name: criterion_channel.py

utilities.name: headroom.py
utilities.what_it_does: Recovers RC-06 unaided hit rates per rating band from stored d'/c; realised range (H - chance)/(1 - chance) with chance 0.317; sensitivity vs criterion decomposition robust to anchor.

features.name: rule-class trigger_state (RC-00..RC-21, 17 classes)
features.definition: trigger(board, ctx) -> 'positive'|'negative'|None from the board plus Context(prev_move, prev_was_capture) only (C1 ENFORCED: 'It has no parameter through which the played move could reach it'). Examples: RC-05 T+ iff queen promotions exist to exactly one square q and nothing attacks q; RC-07/08/09 designated threat to queen/rook/minor; RC-02 prev_was_capture.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes as a cue detector on erez281's positions (code in research/measurement/rule_classes.py; population base rates in corpus_manifest.trigger_counts)
features.admissible_for_validation: yes, if the class's noise cell is not VACANT/SATURATED (C11) and the predicate does not branch (only RC-06 branches)
features.leakage_notes: None from the played move by construction; RC-02 uses the opponent's previous move (pre-decision information).

features.name: b_moves / n_satisfying / n_violating / prescription_size
features.definition: B(s) = legal moves satisfying the class's response predicate; prescription_size = n_satisfying / n_legal; no_satisfying_move, no_violating_move flags.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes (engine-free)
features.leakage_notes: Predicate is a property of the move alone for all classes except RC-06 (branches on trigger).

features.name: n_legal / n_legal_moves, n_legal_captures, n_checks_available, n_mate_in_1, n_forcing_moves
features.definition: Counts over legal moves of the side to move (forcing = captures union checks).
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: n_mate_in_1 requires a one-ply push per legal move but uses no engine and no played move.

features.name: material_balance, piece_count, actor_material, opponent_material, total_material, in_check, phase, fullmove_number, halfmove_clock
features.definition: VALUES = {P1,N3,B3,R5,Q9,K0}; balance = actor - opponent; phase label from scan_rule_classes ('opening'|'middlegame'|'endgame').
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes
features.leakage_notes: none

features.name: actor_elo, opponent_elo, time_control
features.definition: Game-level metadata of the 2013 population player; time_control string 'base+inc' seconds.
features.admissible_for_discovery: population only (not erez281)
features.leakage_notes: none; but no clock-remaining field exists anywhere in this corpus.

features.name: v_star_xs / v_star_cp (V*)
features.definition: Full-width Stockfish 17.1 200k-node value of the position for the side to move, xs = (wins + draws/2)/(w+d+l) under python-chess WDL model sf16 at the position's ply; cp with mate encoded at MATE_SCORE 100000 minus n.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes as a difficulty covariate (gate_b.py uses V* as 'difficulty'); it is engine information the player never sees
features.admissible_for_validation: yes as covariate, not as a human-observable cue (GATE-CUE-PLAYER-OBSERVABLE refuses engine-requiring cues)
features.leakage_notes: Position-only; does not depend on the played move.

features.name: V_B, V_notB, regret_b_xs, advantage_xs, max_regret_in_b_xs, chance_advantage_xs
features.definition: V_B = max engine value over B (root-restricted); V_notB = max over complement; regret_B = V* - V_B (what obeying costs at best); advantage = V_B - V_notB (what disobeying costs); max_regret_in_b = V* - min over B; chance_advantage = same contrast for a seeded size-matched random partition (levels not preserved).
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes as position-level rule-safety covariates (engine)
features.admissible_for_validation: yes as covariates; these are properties of the position and rule, not of the player
features.leakage_notes: Computed from the position and B only; no played move.

features.name: b_valid
features.definition: 1 iff the engine's full-width argmax move is a member of B.
features.admissible_for_discovery: discouraged: killed as a safety statistic (false alarm / false comfort)
features.admissible_for_validation: no as a target; see killed_paths
features.leakage_notes: none

features.name: Per-move regret within B: regret = v_star_xs - xs(candidate)
features.definition: For each candidate move in B, its own multipv-over-B line value; regret of choosing that permitted move. rank_within_b, n_in_b also stored.
features.admissible_for_discovery: yes as the engine label for ranking candidates before commitment (this is the P3/PE target)
features.admissible_for_validation: yes as label; population positions only
features.leakage_notes: Only for moves inside B; values for moves outside B not preserved.

target_definitions.name: Expected score xs
target_definitions.definition: xs = (wins + draws/2) / (wins + draws + losses) from python-chess WDL model 'sf16' at the position's ply, POV side to move; forced mate maps to exactly 1.0 or 0.0.
target_definitions.thresholds: Primary scale for every regret/advantage quantity; cp is diagnostic only.

target_definitions.name: Centipawn conventions
target_definitions.definition: MATE_SCORE = 100_000 ceiling; python-chess returns mate_score - n for mate in n; is_mate(cp) = |cp| > MATE_SCORE - MATE_BAND with MATE_BAND = 1_000; cp regrets excluded when either end is a mate.
target_definitions.thresholds: BLUNDER_CP = 100 ('action_set.py's own definition of a real error').

target_definitions.name: regret_B, advantage, per-action regret
target_definitions.definition: regret_B = V* - V_B; advantage = V_B - V_notB; per-action regret of permitted move m = V* - V(m); per_item_worst = max over B; per_item_median.
target_definitions.thresholds: share_of_permitted_actions_losing_100cp_or_more counts d >= 100 cp; 'UNSAFE PERMITTED SET' failure fires when per_action_regret p90 >= 0.5 xs; 'NOT NECESSARY' when mean advantage_xs on T+ <= 0.

target_definitions.name: Single-best-move audit
target_definitions.definition: FALSE ALARM: b_valid = 0 and regret_B <= 0. FALSE COMFORT: b_valid = 1 and worst permitted regret >= 0.25 xs.

target_definitions.name: Item-bank labels
target_definitions.definition: hard_negative: negative cell, has a satisfying move, regret_b_xs >= 0.10; soft_negative otherwise; boundary_permitted_set_contains_a_losing_move: max_regret_in_b_xs >= 0.5.

target_definitions.name: played-move cost bands
target_definitions.definition: regret_played_xs = v_star_xs - u_xs; share_free = regret <= 0; share_costing_at_least_0.10_xs; share_costing_at_least_0.25_xs; cp_share_losing_100_or_more.

target_definitions.name: Gate B predicted direction and sham prediction
target_definitions.definition: regret_B: T+ minus T- should be NEGATIVE; advantage: T+ minus T- should be POSITIVE. Sham: regret_b_xs and advantage_xs 95% intervals should include zero. 'The INTERVAL IS THE RESULT, not the t' — no numerical acceptance threshold (PRE_HUMAN_GATES.md).
target_definitions.thresholds: None numeric by design; 95% CI = mean +/- 1.96 se.

target_definitions.name: P3 pairwise accuracy and verdict
target_definitions.definition: Within-position pairs of B moves; exclude |regret_i - regret_j| < EPS = 0.01; tie in prediction scores 0.5; LOCO across RC-07/08/09; 5000 position-cluster bootstraps, seed 20260902.
target_definitions.thresholds: P3-PASS iff pooled M2 > 0.5 AND M2-M1 CI lower > 0 AND M2-M0 CI lower > 0 AND all three classes M2 > 0.5 AND >= 2 class-specific M2-M1 CI lower > 0; P3-PARTIAL iff M2-M1 CI lower > 0; else P3-FAIL.

target_definitions.name: Pressure-Exposure C1-C4 and verdict ladder
target_definitions.definition: C1: OwnExposure_post coefficient > 0 in 3/3 folds AND L+Epost gain over L CI entirely > 0. C2: OpponentPressure_post coefficient < 0 in 3/3 AND L+Ppost gain CI > 0. C3: L+Epost+Ppost gain over L+Epost CI > 0, gain positive in all 3 classes, >= 2 class CIs > 0. C4: delta coefficients signs (+ own, - opp) in 3/3 AND L+Edelta+Pdelta gain over L CI > 0.
target_definitions.thresholds: PE-PASS = C1+C2+C3+C4; PE-POST-PASS = C1+C2+C3; PE-EXPOSURE-ONLY = C1 only; PE-FAIL otherwise. Result: PE-EXPOSURE-ONLY.

target_definitions.name: P4 N-of-1 cue selection and pass rule
target_definitions.definition: Eligible SYSTEM feature = same non-zero sign in 3/3 LOCO folds; pick largest median |standardized coef|; TARGET pair = regret gap >= REGRET_GAP_MIN 0.10 and feature differs with correct direction; CONTROL = feature exactly equal despite gap >= 0.10. Bank 8T+4C / 4T / 8T+4C, seed 20260902.
target_definitions.thresholds: P4-N1-PASS: test TARGET >= baseline TARGET + 0.25; test TARGET >= 0.75; CONTROL does not fall > 0.25; >= 6/8 test TARGET responses; no cue exposure before baseline. Guards: STOP if < 20 eligible TARGET positions; specificity NOT IDENTIFIED if < 8 CONTROL positions; STOP if any new Stockfish search.

target_definitions.name: SDT quantities
target_definitions.definition: d' = z(H) - z(F); c = -(z(H) + z(F))/2; Hautus loglinear H = (hits+0.5)/(n+1); corrected_c = observed_c - move-blind c; realised range = (H - chance)/(1 - chance) with chance 0.317 for RC-06.
target_definitions.thresholds: Floor exclusion (post hoc, declared): FLOOR_MIN_ITEMS 250, FLOOR_RATE 0.02 (drops RC-13, RC-14).

target_definitions.name: Shipped transfer bar
target_definitions.definition: Sitting passes on >= 2 successes in 3 positions; 'replicated' requires two passing distinct dates; success = recall word-overlap floor AND move accurate.
target_definitions.thresholds: TRANSFER_POSITION_COUNT 3, TRANSFER_MINIMUM_SUCCESSES 2, RETRIEVAL_INTERVAL_DAYS [1,3,7,21].

relevance_to_mission: Nothing in this area is admissible evidence about erez281 personally: the item bank, twins, shams and 70,595 engine evaluations are all drawn from lichess_db_standard_rated_2013-01 (60,000 anonymous games), and the only human datum (P4-N1-PASS) is an unnamed single participant on 24 offline two-choice items with no clock — Level 2 on the ecological ladder, explicitly 'not the L5 target'. The area is population-evidence only. What IS reusable for the mission: (1) pre-move, engine-free feature code — rule-class triggers (C1-enforced: board + prev_move only), covariates(), and the 24-name relational system_state() with one-ply candidate hypotheticals; (2) one population-licensed candidate-level predictor with a fixed sign, post_own_overloaded_piece_count (PE-EXPOSURE-ONLY, +5.76 pp CI [+3.93, +7.68] on RC-07/08/09 valid actions), usable as a prespecified feature to test on erez281's decisions, not as a mechanism; (3) the design patterns the mission's own rules demand — minimal functional twins plus a matched sham that does not flip the trigger, difference-of-differences, position-cluster bootstrap, LOCO transfer, frozen prereg with verify_freeze.py, and the move-blind SDT floor; (4) negative knowledge that prunes paths: b_valid is not a safety statistic, SDT criterion is not a player parameter, opponent-pressure counts invert, RC-05 opportunities are too rare/cheap, RC-06 predicate branches, process evidence separates at 0.500. The engine cache is essentially useless for erez281's ~59k depth-12 decisions (different positions, different budget: 200k nodes vs depth 12; cache.py refuses cross-budget hits) except by transposition, and it never preserved candidate gaps over all legal moves.

utilities.name: build_corpus.py (B2 corpus builder)
utilities.what_it_does: From an owner-supplied Lichess PGN export: keeps games where owner is White/Black; rated iff WhiteRatingDiff/BlackRatingDiff present; blitz iff 179 < base + 40*increment <= 479 from the TimeControl header; Variant must be Standard; >=4 %clk readings; sorts newest first; assigns halves by recency parity (even index = derivation); writes research/b2/corpus.json (gitignored) and corpus_manifest.json. Usage: python3 research/b2/build_corpus.py SRC.pgn [OWNER=erez281] [WANTED]. Reports Event-header disagreements but never decides on them.

utilities.name: analyse.py (B2 analysis)
utilities.what_it_does: Reads research/b2/decision_evidence.jsonl + corpus_manifest.json; eligible = not forced, not book, secondsTaken not null; five frozen candidates (raw cut [45,120]; log cut [1,2,4,8,16]; Lichess edges; derivation-fitted quartiles; clock% pressure cut [25,50,75] of baseClockMs); merge_small iterative floor MIN_BUCKET=20; measure = size-weighted SD of bucket accuracy in pp; null = 95th pct of 1,000 size-preserving shuffles; §7 verdict function; controls: 200 unstratified and phase×standing-stratified outcome permutations, within-cell comparison (cells with >= 2*MIN_BUCKET). --control shuffle-outcome|shuffle-time|constant-outcome|plant-signal. Studies both the newest-40 (rank < 40) and all games. Writes research/b2/analysis.json.

utilities.name: controls.py (B2 positive/negative controls)
utilities.what_it_does: Builds a synthetic 75-game corpus with no time signal, runs analyse.py under each control, asserts no-signal/shuffles/constant do NOT reach OBSERVATION and plant-signal DOES on both corpora; checks plain-permutation survival <= 12%; three merge_small floor regression cases. Exit 1 on failure.

utilities.name: run_import_harness.ts
utilities.what_it_does: Runs the product's runImportDiagnostic over corpus.json per player with a UCI engine (default 'stockfish', --engine ./scripts/sf-wasm.sh for shipped WASM), depth 12, Threads 1, Hash 16; five runs (A cleared, B repeat, C reversed, D/E warm-hash historical control); dumps decision_evidence.jsonl labelled by keptGameIndexes; writes harness_report.json with reading, readingWithoutBook, bookEffectPp, reproducibility metrics.

utilities.name: run_account_prereg.ts
utilities.what_it_does: Same import path for one named account, three runs (A canonical, B repeat, C reversed), then calls the shipped bridge: worstBucketVerdict, hypothesisFromImport (decisions_before=0), importProgress, resolutionFactor; computes predictedWindow = min(2209, ceil(games*resolutionFactor)) when not-separable; co-primary standard-only analysis via readSubset by keptGameIndexes; writes decision_evidence.jsonl and prereg_report.json. Args --engine, --data, --prereg.

utilities.name: build_account_corpus.ts
utilities.what_it_does: Fetches GET lichess.org/api/games/user/{user}?rated=true&clocks=true&opening=true&pgnInJson=true&sort=dateDesc (needs LICHESS_API_TOKEN; cached to history.ndjson), applies admissible(), takes speed from the API JSON field with speedOf(pgn) as a counted cross-check, keeps the N most recent admissible games (--games, default 48), writes corpus.json (gitignored; contains usernames) and corpus_manifest.json (salted playerId, gameIds, corpusSha256).

utilities.name: admissible() / speedOf() / MIN_PLIES
utilities.what_it_does: admissible: Termination == 'Normal', PGN contains %clk, White/Black/Site id present, >= MIN_PLIES=20 %clk readings in movetext. speedOf: 'Rated <class> game|tournament|swiss' regex, else ARENA_CLASSES longest-first (ultrabullet, hyperbullet→bullet, superblitz→blitz, classical, rapid, blitz, bullet). Also builds the six-player open-database corpus (stratified by dominant time class, first N by username).

utilities.name: decisionsFromGame / diagnoseImportedGames / worstBucketVerdict / resolutionFactor
utilities.what_it_does: Turns an ImportedGameInput (fens, evalScores White-relative, clockTimes, timeControl, playerColor, speed) into ImportedDecision rows for the player's plies; builds the nine-bucket diagnostic (six shared BUCKETINGS + three IMPORT_BUCKETINGS by standing); clock buckets read only the dominant speed class; worstBucketVerdict sorts measurable buckets by accurateRate, separation = runnerUp − worst, threshold = standardErrors(=2) * sqrt(p1(1-p1)/n1 + p2(1-p2)/n2); resolutionFactor = (threshold/separation)^2.

utilities.name: pgn-clock.ts
utilities.what_it_does: clockSecondsFromPgn: [base from TimeControl header or NaN, ...%clk readings]; secondsSpentAt(clockTimes, ply, inc) = max(0, clockTimes[ply-2] − clockTimes[ply] + inc), null for ply<2 or non-finite; clockMsRemainingAt = clockTimes[ply-2]*1000 (the clock the player FACED); opponentClockMsRemainingAt = clockTimes[ply-1]*1000; parseTimeControl '300+3'.

utilities.name: hypothesisFromImport / importProgress / isRegistrableBucket
utilities.what_it_does: Bridge outcomes: registered | nothing-readable | only-one-readable | not-separable | not-registrable (worst bucket not collectible in live loop, e.g. clock-under-1m). Registered hypothesis carries bucket_key, decisions_before, evidence{accurate_rate,n,runner_up_key,separation,threshold,games}, refutation_condition. PREREGISTERED_THRESHOLDS: minBucketN 20, separabilityK 3.25 (vs default 30 / 3.75).

utilities.name: sf-wasm.sh / sf-wasm.mjs / uci-engine.ts
utilities.what_it_does: Drives the shipped stockfish-18-lite-single WASM over UCI on stdio under Node for harness runs (engine id name 'Stockfish 18 Lite WASM').

features.name: secondsTaken (think time)
features.definition: Seconds the player spent on the move at ply: max(0, clockTimes[ply-2] − clockTimes[ply] + incrementSeconds); null for ply < 2 or when the TimeControl header is missing (index 0 NaN). Integer seconds only on Lichess ([%clk] is H:MM:SS).
features.admissible_for_discovery: Used throughout B2 and the account harness as the primary time variable; PREREG §2.2: cannot be separated from position difficulty ('hard positions take longer AND are played worse').
features.admissible_for_validation: Only as a descriptive/covariate feature; it is a consequence of the decision process, not a pre-move condition. It is NOT computable before the move is committed — it is the duration of the decision itself.
features.leakage_notes: Not post-move engine leakage, but it is measured by the move's own completion; correlates with difficulty. Increment must be added back (300+3) or thinking reads as 0s.

features.name: clockMsRemaining
features.definition: Milliseconds on the player's own clock as FACED before the move: clockTimes[ply-2]*1000; null for ply<2 or no clocks. Bucket 'clock-under-1m': < 60_000.
features.admissible_for_discovery: Yes (used by clock-under-1m and B2 'time pressure' = 100*clockMsRemaining/baseClockMs cut at 25/50/75%).
features.admissible_for_validation: Yes — a condition of the decision.
features.leakage_notes: None. B2 time-pressure buckets are confounded with phase (low-clock bucket has no opening decisions).

features.name: opponentClockMsRemaining
features.definition: Opponent's clock while the player decides: clockTimes[ply-1]*1000; null for ply<1.
features.admissible_for_discovery: Available in ImportedDecision but NOT written to decision_evidence.jsonl and not used by any bucket in this area.
features.admissible_for_validation: Yes in principle; never measured here.
features.leakage_notes: None.

features.name: phase
features.definition: classifyPhase(fenBefore, ply): 'endgame' if non-pawn non-king material of BOTH sides <= 13 points (n=b=3, r=5, q=9); else 'opening' if ply <= 20; else 'middlegame'. Read off the position BEFORE the move (since 'cycle 48').
features.admissible_for_discovery: Yes; buckets phase-opening/middlegame/endgame.
features.admissible_for_validation: Yes; a heuristic 'not a fact about the position' (docs/MEASUREMENTS.md referenced).
features.leakage_notes: None. Endgame threshold means many simplified middlegames are 'endgame'.

features.name: standing
features.definition: standingFrom(facing): 'winning' if eval before the move (mover's side) >= +100cp; 'losing' if <= −100cp; else 'level'. facing = evalScores[ply-1] flipped to the mover's side.
features.admissible_for_discovery: Yes (IMPORT_BUCKETINGS standing-winning/level/losing); import-only, cannot be registered as a live hypothesis because the live loop forbids the engine speaking before a decision (R3).
features.admissible_for_validation: Yes as a pre-move position property, but it depends on the ENGINE's evaluation, so it differs by engine (ENGINE_PARITY: 72 rows changed standing between engines).
features.leakage_notes: Uses engine eval of the pre-move position only; no post-move information. Engine-dependent.

features.name: forced
features.definition: onlyLegalMove(fenBefore): chess.js legal move count == 1; false if the FEN will not load.
features.admissible_for_discovery: Exclusion criterion (eligible excludes forced).
features.leakage_notes: None. Only exactly-one-legal-move; 'forced-in-all-but-name' recaptures are not excluded (ACCOUNT_BRIDGE_RESULTS §2 caveat on endgame).

features.name: book
features.definition: isBook(fenBefore): position key (32-bit FNV-1a over positionKey) is in BOOK_KEYS — positions reached by >= 0.10% of 73,279 Lichess games (2026-03 dump, 24,000,000-byte prefix) within the first 30 plies; 833 positions. NO_BOOK when not loaded.
features.admissible_for_discovery: Exclusion criterion; book removal lowers phase-opening accuracy by 3.6–3.9pp on erez281 (bookEffectPp).
features.leakage_notes: None; a claim about the position, not the move.

features.name: speed (time class)
features.definition: Lichess time class per game: from the API 'speed' field (account corpus) or speedOf(Event tag) (open database). Clock buckets read only the dominant class per player (dominantSpeed = most frequent among decisions); other-class decisions counted as excludedForSpeed. B2 build_corpus: blitz iff 179 < base + 40*inc <= 479.
features.admissible_for_discovery: Yes (context variable).
features.leakage_notes: Historic defect: Event-header parsing lost class for 1,104/2,209 arena games; fixed by using the API field.

features.name: ply
features.definition: Half-move index in the game; odd plies are White's. Used by phase (ply<=20) and by pre-move clock indexing.
features.admissible_for_discovery: Yes.
features.leakage_notes: None.

features.name: timeControl (baseSeconds, incrementSeconds)
features.definition: Parsed from PGN [TimeControl 'base+inc']; B2 manifest baseClockMs = base*1000 (180000 or 300000) used as the denominator for time-pressure %.
features.admissible_for_discovery: Yes (context).
features.leakage_notes: None. Must NOT be inferred from max clock reading (Amendment 2b).

features.name: colour (owner white/black)
features.definition: B2 build_corpus records '_colour' w/b (internal only, not in the manifest); harness uses playerColor to select the owner's plies.
features.admissible_for_discovery: Available but not analysed in any B2/harness report; the B2 build script prints white/black counts to stdout only.
features.leakage_notes: None.

features.name: Lichess encoding buckets of secondsTaken
features.definition: Bucket index by edges [0.1, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 60] s (index i if s < edge[i], else 16).
features.admissible_for_discovery: B2 winning candidate (by 0.69pp).
features.leakage_notes: Sub-second edges inert on integer-second data.

features.name: log seconds buckets / player's own quartiles
features.definition: log: cut at [1,2,4,8,16] s. Quartiles: 25/50/75th percentiles of secondsTaken fitted on the derivation half only.
features.admissible_for_discovery: B2 candidates; both beat null on both halves.
features.leakage_notes: Quartiles fitted on derivation half only (no held-out fitting).

features.name: cpLoss
features.definition: max(0, evalBefore − evalAfter) from the mover's side (White-relative evalScores flipped), engine depth 12.
features.admissible_for_discovery: Outcome variable only.
features.admissible_for_validation: Outcome only — POST-MOVE, must never be a feature.
features.leakage_notes: Post-move by construction. Engine-dependent (13.61% verdict flips native vs shipped).

features.name: evalScores / facing (pre-move engine eval)
features.definition: evalScores[ply-1] flipped to mover's side; used for standing and for the accuracy rule's anchor.
features.admissible_for_discovery: Yes as a pre-move position property (import only).
features.admissible_for_validation: Yes for imported games; forbidden in the live loop (R3).
features.leakage_notes: Pre-move only. Not written to decision_evidence.jsonl (only 'standing' is).

target_definitions.name: accurate (decision accuracy)
target_definitions.definition: accurateDecision(engineEvalCp, cpLoss) = winProbabilityLoss(engineEvalCp, cpLoss) <= ACCURATE_WIN_PROBABILITY_LOSS, where winProbability(cp) = 1/(1+exp(−0.00368208·cp)) (Lichess AccuracyPercent.scala logistic, fitted on 2300-rated games), winProbabilityLoss = max(0, winProbability(eval) − winProbability(eval − cpLoss)), and ACCURATE_WIN_PROBABILITY_LOSS = winProbabilityLoss(15, 30) — i.e. what 30cp costs anchored at +15cp (≈2.761pp of winning chances). engineEvalCp = the pre-move evaluation from the mover's side.
target_definitions.thresholds: ACCURATE_CP_LOSS = 30 (the legacy raw cut, now only the anchor). Equivalent cp tolerance: ~30cp at 0, ~38cp at +300, ~58cp at +500, ~212cp at +1000. Depth 12, Stockfish 18 Lite WASM, Threads 1, Hash 16, hash cleared.

target_definitions.name: accurateRate (bucket)
target_definitions.definition: Share of eligible decisions (not forced, not book, and for clock buckets: dominant speed class only) with accurate == true inside the bucket. Null / unmeasurable when n < MIN_BUCKET_N ('too-few') or when no clock data ('no-clock-data').
target_definitions.thresholds: MIN_BUCKET_N = 30 (product default); PREREGISTERED_MIN_BUCKET_N = 20.

target_definitions.name: eligible decision
target_definitions.definition: Scored decision with !forced && !book (product); B2 additionally requires secondsTaken !== null. Scored = owner's plies with cpLoss computable, fenBefore loadable.
target_definitions.thresholds: B2: 3,067 scored − 336 book − 11 forced = 2,720 eligible. Full account: 59,419 − 6,213 − 325 = 52,881.

target_definitions.name: Six shared BUCKETINGS + three import buckets
target_definitions.definition: fast-under-45s: secondsTaken < 45; slow-over-2m: secondsTaken > 120; phase-opening/middlegame/endgame: phase ==; clock-under-1m: clockMsRemaining < 60_000. Import-only: standing-winning (eval >= +100cp), standing-level, standing-losing (<= −100cp).
target_definitions.thresholds: 45 s, 120 s, 60,000 ms, ±100 cp, phase: non-pawn material <= 13, ply <= 20.

target_definitions.name: worstBucketVerdict separability (account bridge)
target_definitions.definition: Sort measurable buckets by accurateRate; worst = lowest, runnerUp = second lowest; separation = runnerUp.rate − worst.rate; threshold = 2 · sqrt(p_w(1−p_w)/n_w + p_r(1−p_r)/n_r); separable iff separation > threshold. resolutionFactor = (threshold/separation)^2; predictedWindow = min(2209, ceil(games · factor)).
target_definitions.thresholds: standardErrors = 2 (unchanged, 'No threshold moves'). Observed: 48g thr 6.985pp; 1,240g thr 1.145pp; 2,209g thr 0.863pp.

target_definitions.name: B2 separation measure and bar
target_definitions.definition: spread = 100·sqrt(Σ_b n_b (p_b − p̄)^2 / n) in pp over merged buckets (iterative merge until every bucket >= MIN_BUCKET); bar = 95th percentile of 1,000 outcome shuffles preserving bucket sizes; result read on held-out half; boundaries/quantiles fitted on derivation half.
target_definitions.thresholds: MIN_BUCKET = 20 ('chosen after §4 was frozen'); NULLS = 1000; PERMUTATIONS = 200; SEED = 20260830; PREREGISTERED_N = 40. Verdict rows: STOP-B2-A / -B / -C / OBSERVATION as in analyse.py verdict().

target_definitions.name: Live detector separability (not exercised in this area, referenced)
target_definitions.definition: Calibration gap inside vs outside a bucket at SEPARABILITY_K standard errors with MIN_BUCKET_N on each side; PREREGISTERED_THRESHOLDS relax to n=20, K=3.25 when a bridge hypothesis narrows the search to one bucket.
target_definitions.thresholds: SEPARABILITY_K = 3.75; PREREGISTERED_SEPARABILITY_K = 3.25; MAX_SHUFFLED_FALSE_POSITIVE_RATE = 0.02.

target_definitions.name: Engine parity thresholds (six-player harness)
target_definitions.definition: T1 display resolution = 1.0pp; T2 verdict resolution = smallest of the six players' separability bars = 13.0pp; Δ = largest bucket accuracy shift between engines.
target_definitions.thresholds: Δ = 13.6pp > T2 = 13.0pp → STOP-B1.

target_definitions.name: admissible game (account harness)
target_definitions.definition: Termination == 'Normal', PGN contains %clk, >= 20 %clk readings, White/Black/id present. Variant NOT checked (48 From Position/Atomic games admitted but dropped downstream as unreadable).
target_definitions.thresholds: MIN_PLIES = 20. erez281: 2,209 admissible of 3,195 rated (Abandoned 124, Time forfeit 724, under-20-plies 134, no-clocks 4).

relevance_to_mission: This area supplies the mission's L0 signal layer and its main hazards. (1) What exists for erez281 at the decision level, all on accuracy-as-proxy at depth 12 on the shipped WASM engine: nine-bucket rates at four corpus sizes (48 / 117 blitz / 1,240 / 2,209 games), the by-game derivation/held-out split of the 117 blitz games, and the think-time gradient (28.8–35 points, monotone, inside 'fast-under-45s'). The per-decision rows (~59k) are NOT committed; only sha256s and the schema {playerId, gameIndex, gameId, ply, phase, secondsTaken, clockMsRemaining, cpLoss, accurate, standing, forced, book, speed} — they must be regenerated (build_account_corpus.ts needs LICHESS_API_TOKEN; ~90 min per engine pass for the full account) before any per-decision mechanism work, and the shipped 1,240/2,209 evidence files carry a mislabelled gameId column. (2) Pre-move features the pipeline already preserves: phase, clockMsRemaining, standing (engine pre-move eval), forced, book, speed, ply, timeControl, opponentClockMsRemaining (in memory only), colour (B2 only). secondsTaken is NOT pre-move — it is the decision's own duration — and the repo's strongest gradient rests on it, with the documented difficulty confound (PREREG §2.2) unresolved except that inside the middlegame the separation survives phase×standing stratification (3 of 7 cells). (3) Population vs player-specific: the same gradient shape and the same 'fast-under-45s is the record' fact appear in the six-player canonical record, so the time gradient is at least partly population-level and must not be read as this player's mechanism without a population baseline. (4) Hard limits already established: no bucket at the bottom is separable from its neighbour over the whole account ('cannot register'); the largest structure is at the top (endgame ~80%, clock-under-1m ~69%), which the downward-looking instrument is not built to see; 'slow-over-2m' can never fill; engine choice moves 13.61% of accuracy verdicts. (5) Cross-context (opening/colour/material/clock) is only coarsely represented — phase, standing, speed — no opening, colour, opponent or material features are in any committed evidence, so L1 cross-context pattern work needs regeneration with a richer row schema.
